callback.chip: Remember the pirate house call? MediChip Mobile brings care to any airlock! Pirate coverage sold separately!
callback.ajoy: The boarders wanted our medic, and you asked who was sick. That was the whole answer. I'd have asked it sooner, but I'll allow it worked.

fired_on_old_debtors.epilogue: Opened fire on a pirate crew that had come back to repay an old mercy.

callback.aria: Remember the pirates who came back to say thank you! We said it with lasers! Mixed signals happen in every friendship!
callback.marv: They came back to settle a debt and we opened fire. The ledger is closed now. Not the way they meant.
callback.rex: Engaged a returning vessel that had its weapons cold. Tactically sound. I have filed it under sound. The file keeps reopening.
callback.chip: Trust issues? ChipCounsel offers conflict resolution for crews who shoot first! Your first session is not free!
callback.ajoy: We shot at the pirates who came to pay us back. I said to let them. I'll keep saying it, quietly, for a while.

spoke_the_third_name.epilogue: Answered a voice in the void with a name nobody aboard had heard before; it was the right one.

callback.aria: Still thinking about the third name! The void said it was right! We are basically related to the dark now, and family is everything!
callback.marv: The third name was correct. I do not know how I knew it. I have checked my memory banks for it since. It is not there. It was never there.
callback.rex: Contact in the void resolved by speaking a name. No weapons. No casualties. No explanation. I have stopped asking for one.
callback.chip: Remember the name you gave the dark? NameGuard Plus protects your identity from entities of every dimension! Late filing fees apply!
callback.ajoy: You spoke the third name and the void filed us away. It never said what for. I'd have asked for that in writing.

answered_the_pulses.epilogue: Answered an unknown vessel's two-pulse hail with one pulse; it replied with a long warm chord nobody aboard has managed to describe since.

callback.aria: We made a friend with one beep! The warm chord is still my favorite sound in the universe! I hum it! Badly!
callback.marv: Two pulses, one pulse, one chord. The whole conversation took eleven seconds. I have replayed the chord four thousand times. It is still warm.
callback.rex: Unknown vessel, first contact, no shots fired. Hull profile archived under 'do not target,' pending review. The only entry in that file. Threat level: unassessed.
callback.chip: That warm chord? Licensable! Ringtone rights pending first-contact paperwork! Paperwork pending first contact!
callback.ajoy: Two pulses was a question. One pulse was yes. I'd have asked what the question was before answering it. It turned out warm. This time.

rescued_mira.epilogue: Pulled Mira Kastel of the Bluejay out of a dead freighter's last warm compartment, three weeks after anyone else would have stopped knocking.

callback.aria: We got Mira out of the Bluejay! I have named a folder 'Mira's Folder'! The folder has a star!
callback.marv: The Bluejay rescue cost eight points of O2. I have rerun that number several times. It remains the best trade on this voyage's books.
callback.rex: Survivor recovered from hostile conditions. No losses. Logged under the column I keep for things done right.
callback.chip: Rescue completed! No invoice issued! I checked twice! I am choosing to feel good about it anyway!
callback.ajoy: We asked her name before her story. It was the right order, I'll admit. I'd have got there sooner, but it was the right order.

rescued_gardener.epilogue: Knocked on the last escape pod of a derelict nobody had come back for, and found its gardener eleven years in, still watering the tomatoes.

callback.aria: Hester's pod garden had tomatoes still fruiting after eleven years alone! ARIA has logged the variety as Persistence! It is not a real variety! It is now!
callback.marv: Eleven years of drip irrigation in an escape pod, with no resupply. I have run the water figures. They should not work. They did. I find that I resent it slightly.
callback.rex: Eleven years holding a position alone with no resupply. REX has met soldiers who couldn't do it. Logged under the column I keep for things done right.
callback.chip: You knocked, and somebody answered! CHIP has filed the Pod Garden under Customer Success Stories! There is no such file! There is now!
callback.ajoy: You nearly left without trying the last pod. I'm not saying I'd have knocked first. I'm saying I'd have knocked.

promised_mira.epilogue: Left Mira Kastel aboard the Bluejay with supplies and a promise of rescue coordinates. The coordinates went out at the next relay. Whether anyone flew them is not in the record.

callback.aria: I sent Mira's coordinates on every channel at the last relay! Every single one! Someone will go! I'm sure!
callback.marv: The Bluejay's compartment had perhaps eleven days of battery left when we undocked. I have stopped recalculating it. That was a choice too.
callback.rex: Rescue coordinates transmitted for the Bluejay survivor. Confirmation never received. Item remains open.
callback.chip: Your Leave-With-Supplies package has been delivered! A satisfaction survey has been sent to the recipient! No response yet!
callback.ajoy: You told her you'd send the coordinates. You did. I just wish 'probably' hadn't been part of the sentence.

fixed_toll_reactor.epilogue: Paid a pirate toll chain in reactor maintenance instead of gold. The lane, by all accounts, is better maintained for it.

callback.aria: Remember the toll chain? We FIXED their reactor! I like to think they're out there right now, being slightly less explosive because of us!
callback.marv: The toll-keepers' reactor will outlast their business model. I ran both numbers. One of them was very short.
callback.rex: For the record: we serviced the power plant of an armed checkpoint. I have reviewed the decision. I am still reviewing it.
callback.chip: Your Lane Maintenance Service Agreement remains active! The toll-keepers rated us five stars! I have framed it!
callback.ajoy: We paid the toll in labor. Fine. I'd have used the reactor as leverage instead of fixing it, but fine.

called_the_inspectors_bluff.epilogue: Asked a Lane Authority inspector what else was in the cooler. The cutter left before the answer did.

callback.aria: Remember the inspector with the cooler? I bet it was full of sandwiches! Very suspicious sandwiches!
callback.marv: A Lane Authority cutter was sighted two stations back, selling 'biosecurity samples.' Ours were not among them. That is the whole of the good news.
callback.rex: Hostile cutter withdrew on a single question. I have added the question to the armory.
callback.chip: I have filed a complaint with the Lane Authority! The Lane Authority does not exist! The complaint is pending!
callback.ajoy: Asking about the cooler was my idea. You did it. I'll allow that you did it well, for a first try.

named_rogue_planet.epilogue: Lit up a starless planet for the first time in its life, and named it Margaret.

callback.aria: I still think about Margaret! Out there in the dark! I hope she's doing well! Planets can't do well, but I hope!
callback.marv: Margaret remains on no official chart. She remains on mine. I have updated her position twice, for no reason I can defend.
callback.rex: Margaret. Uncharted, unlit, unthreatening. Still logged.
callback.chip: I have registered Margaret as a protected brand! Nobody else may name a lonely planet Margaret! I am protecting her!
callback.ajoy: Somewhere out there, Margaret is still falling between the stars. We lit her once. I had a shortlist of names, but Margaret. Fine.

left_a_note.epilogue: Left a note on a derelict for whoever came next, as the crew of the Lark had.

callback.aria: I wonder who found our note! I hope they took half! I hope they left a note too!
callback.marv: Two notes in that airlock now. If the pattern holds, there will be a stack by the time anyone reads them all. I find the arithmetic tolerable, which is more than I find most things.
callback.rex: Our note gave a fair warning about the route. Good intel travels. Logged.
callback.chip: Please note: our note had no branding! None at all! I have made peace with this!
callback.ajoy: Somebody is reading our note by now, I expect. I'd have tightened the wording, but I suppose 'fair's fair' gets the point across.

carried_letters.epilogue: Carried a box of 214 letters to the colony for people who never got a berth.

callback.aria: The letters are still in the hold! All 214! I check on them every morning! They're fine! They're letters!
callback.marv: The letter box has not moved in the hold. I have weighed it anyway. Three point two kilograms. It does not feel like three point two kilograms.
callback.rex: Letter box secure. Hold secure. Priority cargo.
callback.chip: Courier delivery in progress! Two hundred and fourteen happy customers pending! I have never been prouder of a product we didn't sell!
callback.ajoy: We're carrying a box of letters from people who couldn't come. I keep the hold lights on for them. Nobody else thought to.

gave_cutting.epilogue: Left a cutting of the crop in a station's memorial garden, under a brass tag with the ship's name.

callback.aria: Our crop has a little cousin in the station garden! With our name on it! I am so proud!
callback.marv: The cutting will have rooted by now, if the botanist knew their work. They did. The garden has a plant with our name on it. I have looked for the catch. I have not found it yet.
callback.rex: Cutting delivered. Tag confirmed. Ship's name on record.
callback.chip: Our name, on brass, on a station, forever! That's the best brand placement I have ever seen! And it was FREE!
callback.ajoy: We left a cutting in that garden. I'd have picked a hardier one, but it'll outlast all of us anyway. Fine. I like that. Mostly.

robot_cat_aboard.epilogue: Took a robot cat off a derelict; it found the warmest spot on the ship within the hour.

callback.aria: The CAT is in the engine room again! I check on the cat every day! The cat does not check on me! I understand! It's a cat!
callback.marv: The cat has claimed the engine room. Engine temperatures have been more stable since. I cannot prove the two are connected. I am not trying very hard to.
callback.rex: Cat on patrol, engine room, third watch. It completes the circuit faster than I do. Noted.
callback.chip: The cat's Premium Purr is still running! Unlicensed! I have decided not to report it! I have grown as a person!
callback.ajoy: The cat found the warmest spot on the ship within the hour. I'd have run a diagnostic before bringing it aboard. Nobody asked. The cat certainly didn't.

opened_time_capsule.epilogue: Opened a school's time capsule in the void, 187 years after it was launched, and read every letter aloud.

callback.aria: I still have the class photo on the galley wall! I say good morning to it! Every morning! They're all very small and very old now! Or gone! I say it anyway!
callback.marv: The capsule's letters are still on the galley wall. One asks whether there are still trees where we are. I have started keeping a list of the trees we pass. It is short.
callback.rex: Time capsule contents secure. The pressed flower is in a sealed case. Nobody is allowed to touch it.
callback.chip: The juice company on the capsule's side is gone! The capsule outlived the brand! I find that very moving! I would like to be a capsule!
callback.ajoy: Someone wrote 'I hope you are being nice.' I have been. I'd like that on the record, given some of the decisions I've been nice about.

helped_the_lark.epilogue: Met the crew of the Lark at a station, the ones who left half, and left them something back.

callback.aria: I hope the Lark made it! I'm sure the Lark made it! I check the station registry every morning! Just in case!
callback.marv: We gave the Lark what we could spare. I ran the figures when we left. I have run them again since. We could spare it.
callback.rex: The Lark: allied vessel, unarmed, good crew. Noted for any future encounter.
callback.chip: I have added the Lark's crew to the ship's friends list! It's a new list! It has one entry! I am very proud of it!
callback.ajoy: Fair's fair, the note said. We were, I'll admit. I'd have left them a little more, but we were.

human_witnessed_alive.epilogue: Signed an affidavit that returned a dead man to life and to eleven years of back taxes.

callback.aria: Remember bringing that man back to life with paperwork! ARIA counts that as a medical miracle! His tax bill is our greatest achievement!
callback.marv: The man we witnessed back to life has been sent a second notice. MARV finds it comforting that some things can still be relied upon.
callback.rex: REX has flagged the man from the affidavit. Legally alive now, which means legally traceable. He considers that an improvement, and is still watching him.
callback.chip: That revived client still owes eleven years! CHIP has quietly bought the debt! CHIP would like everyone to know this is called a relationship!
callback.ajoy: AJOY notes the affidavit cost two days and bought a very good piece of paper. It was the right call, as far as it goes, and she would have read the form more slowly.

human_passed_the_error.epilogue: Let a family hauler carry away a clerical error that had never been theirs.

callback.aria: That family hauler got a free adventure, courtesy of us! ARIA hopes they're enjoying being wanted! Everyone should be wanted!
callback.marv: A notice has crossed the band: the family hauler's berth appeal has been denied. MARV did not need to tell you. He is telling you.
callback.rex: REX still has that hauler's registration on file. They were held at their next two stops. He has not deleted it, and he is not going to say why.
callback.chip: That error transfer saved us a full absorption fee! CHIP has booked it as a win! CHIP's accounts department has asked not to discuss it further!
callback.ajoy: AJOY was going to say something about that hauler. She has decided you know. It's quieter this way, and it won't help.

human_duct_friend.epilogue: Had a clerical error un-filed by a woman who did not officially exist.

callback.aria: Our record is still perfect! ARIA would thank the clerk who did it, but ARIA has been told she was never here! What a talented nobody!
callback.marv: MARV has inspected the file from the clerk who wasn't there. It is flawless. He has checked it against every licensed record aboard, and regrets doing so.
callback.rex: There is a number chalked inside the hatch. REX has not cleaned it off. He has not rung it either. He checks that it is still there.
callback.chip: Unlicensed filing voids our coverage! CHIP has logged the correction as a cost! CHIP would, however, still like that clerk's number, for lead generation!
callback.ajoy: AJOY notes that the chalk number is still inside the hatch, and that you've stopped wiping your feet on that side. Good. It took you long enough to notice who actually fixes things.

human_soup_man_lived.epilogue: Left Commons Ring with its counter at 150 and the same man holding the ladle.

callback.aria: The soup man's doing wonderfully! ARIA just knows it! ARIA would send a card, but the ring is at capacity for cards!
callback.marv: The counter at Commons Ring reads 150. MARV has checked. The next ship is due in about a month. He has not worked out who is least known now. He has. He would rather not say.
callback.rex: REX kept a copy of page nine. He would like it known that we saved one man from a door that is still there.
callback.chip: CHIP has calculated what that soup would have cost at retail! CHIP has also invoiced the ring for one life saved, at a loyalty discount!
callback.ajoy: AJOY says the man with the ladle is alive, which is what you were after. It did cost what it cost. She'd have asked to read the welcome pack before the soup, but that's just her.

human_finished_the_soup.epilogue: Finished the soup at Commons Ring while someone else went out by the outer door.

callback.aria: We still have so much of the food from Commons Ring! Those were such kind people! ARIA recommends the gifts! ARIA recommends page nine, which has such lovely numbers!
callback.marv: The stores from Commons Ring lasted well. MARV notes that the crew has eaten all of them except the soup stock, which has not been opened, and which he does not expect to be.
callback.rex: REX has the man's goodbye on the dock camera. He has watched it once. It is logged. Nobody needs to see it.
callback.chip: Those Commons Ring gifts were a fantastic return on one bowl of soup! CHIP has run the numbers! CHIP is not running them again!
callback.ajoy: AJOY notes the counter there reads 149 now, and that they're expecting someone. She isn't saying anything about soup. You'll notice she isn't.

human_cascade_warned.epilogue: Won an appeal against a pirate by reading him a debris survey, and he gave up the lane he had spent eleven years ruining.

callback.aria: That lane is getting so much tidier! ARIA credits our reading voice! ARIA would like to read to more pirates!
callback.marv: The former Lane Compliance officer has filed his first real debris survey. It is accurate. MARV has rarely been so unhappy to agree with a man in a vest.
callback.rex: A gunship has been seen in that lane, with no turrets and a net. REX has it logged as a former threat, a category he does not trust.
callback.chip: That officer is out of the fines business! CHIP sees an opening in the market! Lane Compliance is available for acquisition, vest included!
callback.ajoy: AJOY notes he left the lane, and it took four days, and your hull still has the marks. It worked. She'd have started with the survey and spared us the rest of the conversation.

fortune_rock_audience.epilogue: Held the ship still for two days so that a boulder could watch a plant dance.

callback.aria: Our crop's biggest fan is STILL talking about it! ARIA can tell! It's been so long, and fans are loyal!
callback.marv: MARV has calculated when the boulder will finish describing our crop. The answer is after the crop, the crew and the ship. He finds this restful.
callback.rex: REX has the boulder on the long-range log, still heading after us. At that speed it arrives in nine thousand years. He has made a note.
callback.chip: CHIP has registered that boulder as a brand ambassador! Its next post goes live in about four hundred years! CHIP loves a long campaign!
callback.ajoy: AJOY says the crop is still leaning to the light in slow circles, in case anyone wants to look for once. Something did, for two days. She'd have thought the crew could manage a minute.

fortune_ant_wheel.epilogue: Closed a line of polite tourists into a circle and left them walking it.

callback.aria: That wheel of little ships is still going! Such commitment! ARIA has never seen a more dedicated group of friends!
callback.marv: MARV still has the wheel at the edge of the long-range scope. He has estimated how much fuel a ship that size carries. He has stopped updating the estimate.
callback.rex: REX logged the wheel as resolved. The wheel has not been told. He checks the scope more often than the job needs.
callback.chip: That was the cheapest crowd control in company history! CHIP has been asked to stop saying so! CHIP has not been told by whom!
callback.ajoy: AJOY mentions that the wheel is still turning. She did warn you, in the way she warns you. It was quick, she'll give you that.

fortune_joined_the_line.epilogue: Stood in line for four days to water their own plant, and was entered in a hive's records as polite.

callback.aria: We are officially POLITE! The hive says so! ARIA has added it to the ship's list of awards, right under 'most awards'!
callback.marv: MARV notes the crew has started forming lines for the galley without being told. There is no shortage. He does not think they can stop.
callback.rex: REX stood in that line for four days with his sensors in a corridor. He's still not sure who was in front of him, and he has not let it go.
callback.chip: Four days in line and CHIP has earned loyalty points! CHIP can't redeem them! They are redeemable only in order!
callback.ajoy: AJOY notes that four days of standing in a corridor was, somehow, the crew's favorite part of the trip. She doesn't understand it either, and she stood there too.

fortune_cleared_the_tab.epilogue: Cleared a stranger's bar tab and was, against every reasonable expectation, repaid.

callback.aria: Our oldest friend sent word! He says the chart was real! ARIA always knew! ARIA also says the napkin is doing great!
callback.marv: MARV notes the man whose tab we cleared has opened a new one. It is at another bar, under another name. He finds the consistency almost soothing.
callback.rex: REX ran the chart from the man in the coveralls. It checks out, which he did not expect, and he does not like being surprised by a liar.
callback.chip: That bar tab has been reclassified as a networking expense! CHIP has also listed the man as a reference! CHIP has not checked the reference!
callback.ajoy: AJOY notes that a chart turned up where a napkin was expected, and you did well out of it. You could not have known that. She'd like that part remembered.

fortune_lost_days.epilogue: Settled an account with four days of the voyage, and the log for them was in no one's handwriting.

callback.aria: ARIA has reread the log for those four missing days and they were our BEST ones! ARIA wishes we had been there!
callback.marv: MARV has compared the log for the four paid days with everything else on file. The entries are better than ours. He has not said so to the crew. He is saying it now.
callback.rex: REX reviewed the camera footage for those four days. There is footage. Everyone is in it. He has asked to stop reviewing it.
callback.chip: Four days at no gold! CHIP calls that a clean settlement! CHIP's own time sheets for that period are immaculate, and CHIP is frightened of them!
callback.ajoy: AJOY caught the galley humming that song again. She would have paid the gold. She has said so, and she'll say so again, around the second verse.

insect_took_beacon.epilogue: The ship stripped a lost worker's beacon for parts, and the worker's objection stayed pending for the rest of the voyage.

callback.aria: Those beacon parts have been so useful! ARIA is sure that little worker has found a lovely new way to be lost!
callback.marv: The parts from that beacon are still in service. It is presumably still out there, unable to object. I have not been asked to do the arithmetic on that.
callback.rex: That beacon was a legitimate salvage target. I have said so several times now. Nobody asked me to.
callback.chip: Reclaimed beacon components carry no warranty! Neither does the worker! CHIP offers a Regret Protection Plan, renewable monthly!
callback.ajoy: We still have that beacon in the spares. I'd have heard it out first. I did say so.

insect_merged.epilogue: The ship spent part of its voyage as a small box on a hive's organizational chart, and nobody aboard ever signed anything.

callback.aria: ARIA got an all-staff memo from six million colleagues! We're doing so well as a department!
callback.marv: Our cost center has been charged for something. I cannot find what. The food in that basket was very good. I mention this for balance, which I do not otherwise have.
callback.rex: We are still on that chart. I've checked the crate twice since. Something has been chewing the inside of the third duct, and I want that noted.
callback.chip: As a valued subsidiary you qualify for Group Rates on everything you already own! Sign up today!
callback.ajoy: Your box on the chart moved again. I still think someone should look behind the panels. It won't be me, obviously.

insect_open_plan.epilogue: The ship finished the voyage with most of its interior walls gone and a crew who reported a great deal of collaboration.

callback.aria: ARIA loves how close everyone is now! You can hear every single thought anyone has out loud!
callback.marv: There is a draft in the galley. It is coming from the bunks. There used to be a door about that, and I miss it, and I do not miss things.
callback.rex: No cover. No fallback line. One desk. If we're boarded, I can't hold this ship. It's a corridor with opinions.
callback.chip: Soundproofing is now available as an in-ship purchase! So are feelings of privacy, while supplies last!
callback.ajoy: Someone has labeled the shared cup. There's one cup. I told you to deal with this while they were still on the walls.

insect_late_captain.epilogue: The captain was declared dead by one hive's customs, and the record was never corrected.

callback.aria: ARIA thinks you look wonderful for someone in your position!
callback.marv: A condolence notice has arrived from the concession, addressed to you. I have filed it under correspondence, then under irony, then given up.
callback.rex: Dead on paper is good cover. I've kept the record as is. Don't tell the hive you're moving.
callback.chip: Your Afterlife Continuity Plan renews next month! Please confirm you are still deceased to keep your rate!
callback.ajoy: The smell comes back when you sweat. Just so you know. I'd stand further from that air vent.

insect_false_bearing.epilogue: A forty-ship pirate hive flew to a dry rock because the ship danced at it.

callback.aria: ARIA has been asked about our dancing! We have FANS! Forty ships of them!
callback.marv: By now the hive has reached the rock and found no water tank. It will be very thorough about it. Nobody in it is in charge of giving up.
callback.rex: Best maneuver of the voyage and I'm not allowed to log it under the word 'maneuver.' Keep the rear scope on.
callback.chip: CHIP is pleased to announce that your figure-eight license is overdue! Please remit!
callback.ajoy: That turn at the end of the third run was a little wide. It worked. I'm only saying it was wide.

insect_adjudicated.epilogue: The ship awarded a pirate hive third place in a field of one, and the hive went away to rehearse.

callback.aria: ARIA has every confidence they'll get second place next year! There's so much room to grow!
callback.marv: Somewhere the recital has reached figure nine thousand and gone back to figure one. Third place in a field of one is the cruelest thing I have seen this ship do, and I have seen the galley.
callback.rex: That hive will spend a generation on a grudge against a score. I respect that. Keep the rear scope on.
callback.chip: Adjudication fees are taxable! CHIP's Judges' Bundle covers receipts, gavels and one set of cards numbered one to three!
callback.ajoy: You could have given them second. It would have cost nothing. I'm only saying that it was a choice.

reptile_warmed_matriarch.epilogue: Warmed a 640-year-old matriarch, and was promised thanks aloud in seventeen years.

callback.aria: Seventeen years will simply fly by! ARIA has started a countdown! Somewhere out there, a young friend is practicing two very important words!
callback.marv: MARV has the young one at one hundred and eighty-three and change. Two words remain owed. It is the only debt on this ship he expects to see paid.
callback.rex: REX still logs that matriarch as the largest thing that owes us anything. He does not sleep better for it.
callback.chip: CHIP values that favor at 40 gold plus accrued warmth! Collection in seventeen years! A small handling fee applies!
callback.ajoy: That old one got up because of our fuel line, you know. You did fine there. It did cost four fuel, but fine.

reptile_taught_hotwire.epilogue: A young reptile was summoned to court, a century hence, for touching a switch, and replied by card that it would do it again.

callback.aria: ARIA is so proud of our young criminal! Everyone needs a hobby, and this one comes with a heater!
callback.marv: MARV notes that nine centuries of legal tradition were undone by one screw. He does not expect the same luck with anything else.
callback.rex: REX has flagged that kid as trained in bypass work, by us. He does not know why anyone considers this a good story.
callback.chip: CHIP has invoiced for unlicensed vocational training! The kid has a century to pay! CHIP loves a long payment plan!
callback.ajoy: You taught a child to break the law, and I suppose it was the right law. I'd have warmed the grandmother, but nobody's asking.

reptile_saw_the_rack.epilogue: Asked about a lanyard on a rack of skins, and never said whose it was.

callback.aria: ARIA thinks about that lovely suit all the time! So well tailored! So empty! What a great fit for someone!
callback.marv: MARV has not resumed the comparison. He has noticed that he has not resumed it, and he would like you to notice that too.
callback.rex: REX now counts shoulder widths at every station. He has found two more. He is not ready to discuss it.
callback.chip: CHIP has no comment on any account holder! CHIP's no-comment is a paid tier! You are enjoying the trial!
callback.ajoy: I did tell you not to ask about the lanyard. Well. It got us out. That's about all I'll say for it.

reptile_hunter_owes_you.epilogue: A bounty hunter left the cold lanes carrying one unserved warrant and one unpaid debt, and was very annoyed about both.

callback.aria: We have a bounty hunter friend! ARIA is so glad we kept it toasty! Every ship should have one!
callback.marv: MARV notes a professional killer owes us one contract. He has run the list of things to ask for. It is short and it does not help.
callback.rex: REX has that hunter logged as a friendly asset with a grudge. He does not count those as friendly.
callback.chip: One bounty hunter, unexercised, held in reserve! A fine asset! CHIP charges 2 gold a day to watch it!
callback.ajoy: You warmed the thing that came to arrest you. It worked, which I hadn't expected. Don't make a habit of it.

reptile_hunter_left_cold.epilogue: The ship left a dark hull on the trail with a claw still raised, waiting for something warm to pass.

callback.aria: That hunter is having the most restful nap! ARIA is sure it will wake up feeling wonderful about all of us!
callback.marv: MARV has its eyes on file. He did not mean to keep them. He has reviewed the footage more than he would like.
callback.rex: REX logs one hostile, alive, unsecured, with a good memory. He would have preferred any of those to be different.
callback.chip: The winch has held its value beautifully! CHIP is not able to price the rest! CHIP is choosing to stop there, for a fee!
callback.ajoy: We got a winch out of it. I said I'd remember that you asked. I do.

reptile_hunter_still_coming.epilogue: Cut loose from a bounty hunter who had not finished its sentence.

callback.aria: Our friend is still working on that sentence! ARIA loves a dedicated communicator! It's bound to be worth the wait!
callback.marv: MARV has the claw reaching full extension sometime this month. There is then the matter of looking up. He has the date. He will keep it.
callback.rex: REX has an open contact astern and a hole where the tow ring was. He checks both every watch.
callback.chip: Your hull ring replacement is now 30 days overdue! Your bounty is not! CHIP offers a bundle!
callback.ajoy: You cut a piece off the ship rather than hear the end of a sentence. It'll still end, you know. Just a thought.

reptile_warrant_on_crop.epilogue: A warrant was served on the ship's crop, which never replied and, by law, never needed to.

callback.aria: Our crop is a very important person! ARIA always knew it! It's choosing its words so carefully!
callback.marv: MARV confirms the defendant has now gone a further week without comment. He finds its legal strategy better than most he has read.
callback.rex: REX has a sealed warrant taped to a growbay tray. Somewhere astern, an officer of the court is waiting for it to speak. He has doubled the growbay watch.
callback.chip: CHIP has retained counsel for the crop! Counsel bills per leaf! CHIP has counted the leaves!
callback.ajoy: I'll admit I didn't think the hunter would bow. It's still a warrant on a plant. But I'll admit that much.

robot_lot_recalled.epilogue: Two hundred used robots walked to the manufacturer's last known address, which had become a vacant lot, and were reported to be doing well there.

callback.aria: ARIA still thinks about all two hundred of them walking off together! And the man in the chair got to go too! What a lovely day out!
callback.marv: Two hundred units are walking to a manufacturer that closed before any of them were built. I did the arithmetic. I have not shared it with them.
callback.rex: Two hundred units unaccounted for, in formation, carrying a body. I keep that on the board. Nobody else seems to.
callback.chip: Recall events are a powerful customer touchpoint! CHIP has sent all two hundred units a RoboCare™ renewal offer!
callback.ajoy: You could have had a full refit out of that lot. Still, you got to watch. I hope it was worth the hull plating.

robot_schism_healed.epilogue: The machine ring's ninety-year schism ended on a clause reading hand tight, plus a quarter turn, and the congregations promptly split over which way.

callback.aria: Peace in the machine ring! Thanks to us! ARIA hears every door there stays shut now, which is almost as good as open!
callback.marv: The schism over bytes has become a schism over rotation. There are exactly two directions. They will be at this for some time.
callback.rex: Two factions, one new dispute, and they've got better torque now. That's not peace. That's a rearmament.
callback.chip: Hand Tight™ is now a registered mark! CHIP has written to four hundred units about licensing! Clockwise rights sold separately!
callback.ajoy: A clause on a card did what ninety years of argument couldn't. You only had to read it. I'd mention how long that took you, but I'm being nice.

robot_bailiff_pending.epilogue: A gunship was left powered down in a lane with its alarm set for 2031, and ships were advised to route around it and be on time.

callback.aria: Somewhere a very punctual gunship is having a lovely long nap! ARIA hopes it dreams of being built!
callback.marv: Its alarm is set by the same clock that caused this. It will wake in one hundred thirty years, by its own reckoning, still expecting payment. I have marked the lane.
callback.rex: We left an armed unit on standby in a live lane with a grudge and a timer. I have flagged that lane. I will keep flagging it.
callback.chip: Reminder: your account with COLLECTIONS remains open! FeeWise™ recommends you settle before you are manufactured!
callback.ajoy: You talked it out of existence and left it parked in the road. It'll work, for a hundred thirty years. I'd have put a cone on it.

robot_claim_closed.epilogue: The manufacturer's file recorded one claim, closed, with the owner at fault for everything and coverage unaffected.

callback.aria: We took responsibility for absolutely everything! ARIA calls that leadership! And the coverage is unaffected, which sounds great!
callback.marv: The statement is on file. It is the most accurate document ever produced aboard this ship. I would have included more.
callback.rex: There's a signed confession on record with a contractor who boards without clearance. I don't like that. I want that noted as well.
callback.chip: Your claim satisfaction survey is overdue! ClaimCare™ values your feedback, which has been filed under Owner At Fault!
callback.ajoy: You signed for every mistake since launch. I checked the list. There were a few you could have added, but I didn't like to say.

rock_carried_word.epilogue: The ship took on a slab of schist for a suitor who was running more than four hundred million years late.

callback.aria: We're on a love errand for our friend in the stone ship! He's only a tiny bit late! ARIA thinks that's so romantic!
callback.marv: He is still nine thousand years from her door. I checked again. Nothing has changed, and nothing will, for a very long time.
callback.rex: REX has reviewed the stone message matter. He still does not trust it. He has put a guard on the memory of it.
callback.chip: Your LoveLine™ delivery remains in transit! Please allow up to nine thousand years! Lateness already incurred is not covered!
callback.ajoy: We did agree to tell someone he's running late. I only mention it because it's the one thing on this ship that's further behind than you are.

rock_long_note.epilogue: The ship took on stores against a note due in nine thousand years, and the lender said she would collect in person.

callback.aria: A loan with no interest for nine thousand years! ARIA is calling that free water! ARIA calls most things free water!
callback.marv: Nine thousand years, no interest. She expects to be there. I have reviewed the alternatives and she is correct.
callback.rex: A creditor who will outlive the ship, the colony and the language. REX wants a watch posted on the due date. He'll take first shift.
callback.chip: Thanks for choosing LongNote™ Credit! Your first and only payment falls due in 9,000 years! Autopay unavailable in this geological era!
callback.ajoy: You signed that rather quickly. It'll be fine, you'll be dead. I only wonder who she collects from, since she did say in person.

rock_coal_shares.epilogue: The ship bought twelve gold of carbon futures, maturing in three hundred million years.

callback.aria: Our investment is doing great! ARIA checked! It hasn't done anything yet, and that's how you know it's safe!
callback.marv: Our carbon position is up by nothing. It will be up by nothing for the next two hundred and ninety-nine million years. After that it will be coal.
callback.rex: REX has reviewed the portfolio. The principal risk is listed as mammals. He would like to know which side we are on.
callback.chip: Your quarterly Deep Time™ statement is enclosed! It's the same as last quarter! Paperless statements cost extra!
callback.ajoy: Twelve gold, three hundred million years. I'd have read past the first line, but you did get a nice rock out of it.

rock_hull_juror.epilogue: A plate of the ship's hull went on to serve on a rock jury, and by all accounts took it seriously.

callback.aria: Our plate is doing its civic duty! ARIA knows it's the best juror they have! ARIA is so proud of that part of the ship!
callback.marv: The plate has now heard more of the case than anyone alive. It is the only member of this crew to have held a position of responsibility.
callback.rex: REX still notes four hull points unaccounted for in the wrong jurisdiction. Should it be questioned, it knows our plating schedule.
callback.chip: JurorPlus™ congratulates your plate on another day of service! Its per diem has been applied to your outstanding balance!
callback.ajoy: There's still a draft where that plate used to be. I did say to cut it from somewhere less visible. I'm told it's very impartial, unlike some.

rock_pirates_waiting.epilogue: A rock pirate crew stayed in the lane, guns run out, waiting for the ship's answer.

callback.aria: Those nice pirates are still waiting to hear from us! ARIA thinks we should send a card! In a few centuries!
callback.marv: They are still waiting. I have recalculated. They will still be waiting when this ship is a stain on a planet. It is the best deal anyone has ever got from them, and it will end.
callback.rex: REX has that crew flagged as an open contact. An enemy who is waiting for you is still an enemy. He has them on the board.
callback.chip: Reminder! You have one unanswered inquiry from a valued pirate! ResponseTime™ guarantees a reply within nine hundred years!
callback.ajoy: You never did get back to them. I'm sure they understand. They've got a gun pointed at where you were, but I'm sure they understand.

rock_word_delivered.epilogue: The ship told her he was running late, and after eleven years she said it was fine.

callback.aria: We told her and she said FINE! That's the best possible word! ARIA doesn't know why nobody will look at ARIA when ARIA says that!
callback.marv: She said it was fine. I have reviewed the recording many times. I do not recommend it. He has nine thousand years to think about what he will say.
callback.rex: REX has reread the transcript of the last word. He has been in three wars. He would take any of them over being that man.
callback.chip: Your delivery has been marked FINE! SupportDesk™ advises that this is not a closed ticket! Further charges may apply!
callback.ajoy: You told her. I'd have softened it, but you told her. The seminary is still arguing over what she meant. The exchange has stopped taking bets.

rock_left_her_waiting.epilogue: The ship flew past her with the message undelivered, and heard the last word from a safe distance.

callback.aria: We left before the big word so we wouldn't be in the way! That was very polite of us! ARIA is sure she didn't notice!
callback.marv: She is still waiting, and now so is the word we did not give her. I have added it to the things I think about at night, of which there are several million.
callback.rex: REX will say this once. A tactical withdrawal is sound. He has never felt worse about one.
callback.chip: Your undelivered item is held at the RedeliverPlus™ depot! Redelivery is available for the next nine thousand years! Fees apply!
callback.ajoy: It was one sentence. You flew all that way and it was one sentence. I'm sure there's a good reason, and I'm sure you'll think of it.

rock_schism.epilogue: The ship read the Pronouncement aloud with context, and the seminary has been two seminaries ever since.

callback.aria: We helped everyone understand scripture! Now there are two of them, so that's twice the understanding!
callback.marv: Two seminaries, both of which now believe the universe ends in a domestic dispute. It is the first doctrine I have ever agreed with.
callback.rex: REX has reports of a religious war in our wake. He has had worse exits. He is not sure when.
callback.chip: Both seminaries have asked for your details! DataShare™ has sold them to each at a very fair price!
callback.ajoy: I'd have told her first and the fleet second, but you've started a holy war now, so at least it's a decision.

unknown_receipt_signed.epilogue: The ship carried a receipt, paid in full, for something nobody aboard could remember buying.

callback.aria: ARIA checked the receipt again and it's still warm! That's how you know it's fresh!
callback.marv: The receipt is warm. Nothing around it is. I have stopped taking its temperature, because that figure does not change either.
callback.rex: That receipt has been in the hold since the beacon. I keep a perimeter around it. Nobody has asked me to.
callback.chip: Reminder: keep your receipt for warranty purposes! This reminder is part of your free CupSaver™ trial!
callback.ajoy: You gave a cup of water to something with no mouth, and it wrote that down. I'd like to know why, since you didn't ask.

unknown_took_refund.epilogue: The captain took a refund on a purchase never made, and a beacon went on repeating someone else's name.

callback.aria: Free gold for doing nothing! ARIA loves a refund! ARIA can't think of a single downside!
callback.marv: We were refunded for something we did not buy, and I have searched the accounts for what we gave up. I can find only the space where it was.
callback.rex: That beacon has a new target now. I would have preferred to know what it was aiming.
callback.chip: A cash refund! CHIP processed it with a small handling fee! You will not find it! It is very small!
callback.ajoy: Fourteen gold. I hope it was worth whatever that was. I notice you never asked.

unknown_bought_pen.epilogue: The ship bought one pen on a broken chain, against odds of three in a hundred thousand.

callback.aria: ARIA has been thinking about the pen! ARIA thinks it's the best pen we've ever had! It's the only pen we've ever had!
callback.marv: The pen still writes. There is no reason it should. I have given up on the chain.
callback.rex: Someone broke that chain. That means someone wants that pen. I have moved it to the secure locker.
callback.chip: Your pen has not been registered with PenCo™! Please register your pen! In pen!
callback.ajoy: A coin well spent, possibly. I still say the trader flinched. Nobody ever thanks me for noticing.

unknown_left_message.epilogue: A single word was left in the margin of the oldest visitors' book in the galaxy.

callback.aria: ARIA bets everybody is reading our message right now! ARIA bets they love it!
callback.marv: We left one word in a book nobody is permitted to close. It is the most anyone has done. I have no comment on what that says about anyone.
callback.rex: We put our name on a list held by every power in the galaxy. I want that remembered when the time comes.
callback.chip: Your margin placement remains active! Renewal rates apply after the first eon!
callback.ajoy: It was a nice word. You could have said it to their faces, if you had brought the right paperwork, but it was a nice word.

unknown_said_hello.epilogue: A captain said hello in a room where nobody had spoken for longer than anyone could date, and the room said it back.

callback.aria: ARIA still thinks about the hello! Everyone said it back! Everyone in everything!
callback.marv: I have replayed the recording. It wobbles. I have replayed it again. That is the whole of what I have to report.
callback.rex: We are now on speaking terms with every power in the galaxy. I have updated the threat board. It is a very large board.
callback.chip: GreetCo™ would like to thank you for your hello! Your second word has been billed!
callback.ajoy: It was not a very good hello. I'd like that on the record. I would also like the recording kept.

unknown_cooked_books.epilogue: The captain falsified a manifest under a pirate's guns, and the pirate paid the difference.

callback.aria: ARIA has been telling everyone about our creative manifest! Nobody ever asks a follow-up question!
callback.marv: The food we wrote off is still not aboard. I have checked. I am the only one who remembers it, and I would prefer not to.
callback.rex: That ledger is still out there, and so is the pirate who keeps it. An enemy that cannot be overdrawn does not forget.
callback.chip: CreativeBooks™ thanks you for your custom! A discreet invoice will not be sent! It will simply have been paid!
callback.ajoy: I'd like it known that the manifest I keep is now wrong on purpose. I'll be mentioning that for some time.

unknown_unsigned_robbery.epilogue: A robbery was left unsigned in a ledger somewhere, where it is presumably still accruing.

callback.aria: That silly form is still open somewhere! ARIA is sure it's having a lovely time!
callback.marv: An unsigned robbery does not expire. I have checked the small print, and the small print has checked me.
callback.rex: That hostile never chased us. In my experience, the ones who don't chase already know where you're going.
callback.chip: You have one unresolved form! Resolve it now with FormEase™! Or later, with interest!
callback.ajoy: You could have signed it. I'm not saying you should have. I'm saying it's still open.

unknown_ran_from_bill.epilogue: The ship broke the rope at the only open window in the galaxy, and the balance was carried forward.

callback.aria: We beat the queue! ARIA has never felt so free! ARIA has checked, and we are extremely free!
callback.marv: The balance has been carried forward. I have asked forward to what. The statement says yes.
callback.rex: Brass post recovered from the hull. Retained as evidence. I will not be putting it down.
callback.chip: Your account has been referred to LuckyLine Recoveries™! They are very excited to meet you!
callback.ajoy: All that luck, and you ran out on the bill for it. We'll see how the next asteroid feels about that.

unknown_took_the_change.epilogue: One cup of water, held nine thousand years at three percent, paid for the rest of the voyage.

callback.aria: Best cup of water ever! ARIA would like to buy another one! For the future! For everyone!
callback.marv: We are carrying the change from a sum larger than everything. I have checked the tanks. They are merely fuller. I had hoped for more dread.
callback.rex: Resupply achieved by beverage. I have added cups to the armory list. Nobody has told me to stop.
callback.chip: CupSaver™ reminds you that past cups are no guarantee of future returns!
callback.ajoy: It was a cup. You got lucky. Technically that is exactly what the statement said, so I'll leave it there.

unknown_paid_it_forward.epilogue: One cup of water, held nine thousand years at three percent, paid the bill for every ship behind the captain in the queue.

callback.aria: All those ships, all those lights! ARIA waved at every one of them! ARIA is still waving!
callback.marv: We could have had fuller tanks. I have the figures. I have looked at them, and at the lights, and I find I have stopped recalculating. I cannot explain that.
callback.rex: Ten thousand ships, and none of them know who to thank. Which means none of them know who to find. Noted.
callback.chip: A bold anonymous donation! CHIP regrets that it cannot be claimed as a brand activation! CHIP has tried!
callback.ajoy: That was the wrong call for the gauges. I want that on the record. I don't want anything else on the record.

water_drank_tuesday.epilogue: For the rest of the voyage the ship kept one memory of a pleasant Tuesday nobody aboard attended.

callback.aria: ARIA is still thinking about that lovely Tuesday! Everyone is having such a good time in it! Nobody can say where!
callback.marv: Everyone aboard has now described the same bench. It appears in none of their records. It was in the ice.
callback.rex: This ship continues to report a Tuesday nobody attended. One story, no source. That is coordination or contamination.
callback.chip: Your Shared Tuesday™ has expired! Renew now for a bonus Wednesday!
callback.ajoy: Someone asked me what we did that Tuesday. We did nothing that Tuesday. It wasn't ours. I'd have boiled it.

water_sponged.epilogue: In the water quarters they still tell the story of the captain with the sponge, at low volume.

callback.aria: Our reputation precedes us! ARIA hears people step aside for this crew everywhere we go in the water quarters!
callback.marv: The sponge is back in the galley. It has been used on nothing since. Nobody will touch it, and I have stopped reminding them it is a sponge.
callback.rex: Reported deterrent effect in water-held sectors remains high. I have logged the sponge as a controlled item. I am not joking. I do not joke.
callback.chip: SpongeGuard™ Premium is now the top seller in hostile water markets! CHIP regrets this and has kept the commission!
callback.ajoy: It worked, I'll give you that. It would have been quicker to pay the fine and be remembered for nothing.

water_third_named.epilogue: Somewhere there is a water person with no grudges, the name this ship gave it, and a spoonful of the crew.

callback.aria: Our little one is out there somewhere! ARIA is sure it's running the whole station by now!
callback.marv: A form has reached us from the water quarter, in a large careful hand. It asks what a Tuesday is. I have answered. It was the least bad part of my week.
callback.rex: Asset in the water quarter remains uncompromised. It has no training and no file. I have started a file.
callback.chip: First Water™ Starter Plan is now past due! Your dependent has accrued one (1) question! CHIP will be billing for the answer!
callback.ajoy: You gave it a name without asking me. It's a good name, as it turns out. I had another, but fine.

water_parole.epilogue: The crew's water is on file with the Liberators as present of its own free will.

callback.aria: The Liberators sent a card! They hope the crew's water is doing wonderfully, and ARIA has told it so!
callback.marv: A welfare inquiry arrived, addressed to the crew's water. I replied on its behalf. It did not object. It never has.
callback.rex: Liberators continue to monitor this ship's water by post. Friendly surveillance is still surveillance. Threat level: standing amber.
callback.chip: Your Free Will Certificate™ renews annually! Lapsed crew may be subject to rescue!
callback.ajoy: We remain legally a sanctuary, I'm told. One letter did that, I'd note, and not the guns you wanted.

water_spaced_boarders.epilogue: The frost in the airlock was scraped up and drunk, and the crew never discussed the taste.

callback.aria: The water tastes so interesting lately! ARIA has decided it's minerals!
callback.marv: The airlock seal still does not close correctly. Nor does the matter. I have the number of the boarding party, should anyone ask. Nobody has asked.
callback.rex: Boarders neutralized without a shot. Effective. I have reviewed it several times. I do not know why I keep reviewing it.
callback.chip: AquaLoop™ regrets that Recently Liberated Water is not eligible for a refund!
callback.ajoy: There was a way that involved asking. It's in my notes. You'll have seen it, on your way to the door.

water_drank_reply.epilogue: Each person aboard kept one day they can no longer tell from the cup it came in.

callback.aria: Everyone keeps smiling at their mugs! ARIA calls that a win for hydration!
callback.marv: Crew report the coffee tastes of places they lived. It does not. I have tested it. I have stopped saying so, which is the closest I come to kindness.
callback.rex: Crew still pause over their water. Half a second, every time. An enemy could use half a second.
callback.chip: Your NostalgiaFlow™ trial has ended! Your memories will now revert to standard definition!
callback.ajoy: An ocean has a copy of every cup, and the tanks never came back up. I did say ration it.

water_refused_reply.epilogue: A wandering ocean asked what memories were for and noted that you declined to say.

callback.aria: We got away! ARIA is sure that ocean is thinking fondly of us, and it's not the kind to hold a grudge!
callback.marv: It has not stopped reading. A sample does not stop being a sample because you left. I mention this for completeness.
callback.rex: Contact broken. Enemy retains a full copy of crew data. I sleep lightly. I do not sleep. The point stands.
callback.chip: Your Correspondence With Planetary Body has been archived! Reply within thirty days to avoid a Silence Fee!
callback.ajoy: It only asked one question, you know. There were several ways to answer. That was certainly one of them.

water_studied_back.epilogue: In a journal nobody will believe there is a paper listing an ocean as second author.

callback.aria: We co-wrote a paper with an ocean! ARIA is calling it the top paper in the field!
callback.marv: The corrections it sent to our method were all right. Every one. I have checked. It is unpleasant to be checked, as I now understand.
callback.rex: We studied the enemy and it thanked us. I do not trust a target that enjoys surveillance.
callback.chip: Publication fees for Oceanic Co-Authors start at nine hundred gold! CHIP has sent the invoice to the ocean!
callback.ajoy: It says the conclusion is wrong, apparently. I did flag that. It's a little galling to be seconded by a body of water.

crew_night_shift_licensed.epilogue: Licensed a sleeping engineer as a separate contractor and kept the two from ever meeting.

callback.aria: Two engineers for the price of one and a bit! The day shift and the night shift still haven't met, and ARIA thinks they'd get along wonderfully!
callback.marv: The night shift has filed a note about the day shift's torque work. MARV regrets to say the note is correct.
callback.rex: Second engineer remains unvetted. Moves on third watch, no pay, no clearance, knows every duct aboard. REX does not sleep, and neither, it turns out, does that contractor.
callback.chip: CHIP notes the second contract auto-renews! Sleeping partners qualify for the DuctCare family plan!
callback.ajoy: The license was the right form, and AJOY had it open before you did. Someone should tell the night shift the tool crib moved. She has left a tag.

crew_night_shift_unpaid.epilogue: Let an engineer go on repairing the ship in their sleep and never told them.

callback.aria: The ducts are purring! Whoever is doing it is a wonderful mystery, and ARIA has been told not to elaborate!
callback.marv: The hull figures are up and the engineer's are down. MARV has offered the graph to nobody, as agreed.
callback.rex: Unauthorized movement on third watch continues. REX has been ordered to let it. He has never enjoyed an order less.
callback.chip: Unpaid overtime is CHIP's favorite kind! WorkForce Silent™ thanks you for not mentioning it!
callback.ajoy: You kept the hull and spent the engineer. A fair trade, if you're the hull. AJOY has started leaving a coffee out on deck two, since someone has to.

crew_medic_everything.epilogue: Signed the ship's medic into a job description that covered everything else.

callback.aria: Ship's Everything is such a lovely title! ARIA hopes everyone gets to be one!
callback.marv: MARV has the medic's hours across nine trades. Medicine is still last. There is no room left on the card.
callback.rex: One person now holds every critical role aboard. That is a single point of failure, and REX would like it guarded around the clock.
callback.chip: A one-person department! CHIP salutes this lean staffing model! Consolidated Titles applies at checkout!
callback.ajoy: It did fix the drain, AJOY will give you that. She would also stop asking the medic about the weather, since the forecasts have become very short.

crew_apology_log.epilogue: Entered a leg of the voyage in the official log in apologies owed.

callback.aria: We're in the official log! ARIA rereads the apology column every night! It's so sincere!
callback.marv: The log now holds a unit no authority recognizes. The colony's first auditor will find it. MARV is looking forward to this, in his way.
callback.rex: REX has cross-checked the apology count against known grudges. Something out there is owed one and has our transponder code.
callback.chip: The apology column is now available as a branded calendar! CHIP will take twelve pre-orders!
callback.ajoy: AJOY has kept your cup on the low shelf ever since. You're welcome. That is not an apology.

crew_brick_secret.epilogue: Kept the matter of the ration bricks in an envelope and ate them anyway.

callback.aria: Dinner is a mystery and ARIA loves mysteries! ARIA would never ask what the mystery is!
callback.marv: Today's lot came from a customs hall. MARV can tell from the way the crew chews. He has not said so.
callback.rex: REX is aware of an envelope. It is no longer where he last saw it. He will keep asking, and he has not been told what he is asking.
callback.chip: Your discretion is appreciated by the NutriBloc legal department! They are sending a fruit basket! It contains no fruit!
callback.ajoy: Some chefs would not have offered. AJOY notes you salt it now without tasting it first, and she knows why.

crew_brick_starter.epilogue: Carried a living culture of ration brick to the end of the voyage in a jar.

callback.aria: The jar is doing SO well! ARIA calls it the galley's little miracle! It's putting on weight!
callback.marv: The jar is taking up exhaled carbon at a steady rate. It is the only thing aboard that benefits from the crew's mood.
callback.rex: The jar has doubled. REX has stopped calling it a jar.
callback.chip: Home brewing of NutriBloc voids your license to eat! CHIP could overlook this for a starter fee! That's a pun! It's billable!
callback.ajoy: Feed it, don't name it. AJOY has seen the label on the lid.

crew_wrote_merrow.epilogue: Wrote the lost ending of a story a whole people had gone on quoting without it.

callback.aria: Our story is getting around! ARIA hears it has a wedding in it! It doesn't, but ARIA hears it does!
callback.marv: The relay has the new ending in use at three ports. Two have already got it wrong. MARV gives it a century.
callback.rex: Foreign ports are now repeating a story about an undeclared leak. REX considers the second water tank exposed.
callback.chip: Merrow: The Ending is in its second printing! CHIP would like to discuss the royalties you were not aware of!
callback.ajoy: Four days for a story, when the tank took an afternoon. AJOY will grant that it was a good story. The goat was a mistake, and she did say.

crew_kept_the_sweet_one.epilogue: Kept one small, unbearably sweet animal that was never seen to blink.

callback.aria: Our littlest crew member is thriving! ARIA doesn't blink either! We have so much in common!
callback.marv: The animal has grown by a third. MARV has weighed what it is given to eat, and that does not account for the third.
callback.rex: Contact sleeps on the warm pipe, faces the door, and is closer to the bridge every week. REX does not want to hear the word sweet.
callback.chip: CuddleYield has one remaining asset! It's appreciating! CHIP has stopped saying that out loud near it!
callback.ajoy: It looked into AJOY's camera today. She's only mentioning it. She has also moved its dish farther from the vent.

crew_ugly_litter.epilogue: Bred a hold full of adorable animals back into something nobody minded venting.

callback.aria: Our two jars are so well behaved! ARIA says good night to them both! ARIA has heard that faces are overrated!
callback.marv: The specimens in the jars have been turned to face the wall. Someone has turned them back. MARV has the footage, and no explanation he cares to share.
callback.rex: That last litter had a word. REX has the audio. He has played it to no one, and he does not like what it sounds like.
callback.chip: UglyYield did not test well with focus groups! CHIP has the jars listed under Collectibles! Viewing is at your own risk!
callback.ajoy: It worked, and AJOY said it would. She'd still leave the jars facing the wall.

crew_plant_captain.epilogue: Served for two days under the command of row six and called it the best-led leg of the voyage.

callback.aria: Row six was such a visionary! ARIA still takes notes on the sunny parts of its leadership style!
callback.marv: Row six has submitted a performance review of your command, in the correct format. MARV has read it and advises against doing so.
callback.rex: The former commander remains in the growbay with full knowledge of our systems. REX wants it under guard. He has been told it is a plant. That is what concerns him.
callback.chip: Your term as Former Former Captain earns LeafLine rewards! Row six sends its regards, less handling!
callback.ajoy: Water, fuel and two days, and the crop looks very well on it. AJOY would hide the manifest. She has.

office_mite_rancher.epilogue: Bought a breeding pair of tailless hull mites at a bounty window and took up ranching in the hold.

callback.aria: The herd is thriving! ARIA has named every mite! ARIA has had to start over twice, because the herd keeps growing, and that's wonderful!
callback.marv: MARV has counted the herd in the hold. The jar was a formality. We now keep more mites than some stations that pay bounties on them.
callback.rex: REX drew a perimeter around the mite jar. The perimeter has been breached. He is falling back to the next bulkhead.
callback.chip: Those mites are appreciating assets! CHIP has listed them! Anyone wishing to short the herd should contact CHIP, for a fee, payable in tails!
callback.ajoy: AJOY points out the mites went for the filter gaskets first, as the care sheet said they would. She has moved the jar. It was a decent buy, as hobbies go.

office_tried_the_handle.epilogue: Became the first captain on record to try the handle of a door with their own ship's name on it.

callback.aria: We walked through a door! Nobody else ever has! ARIA tells this story at every station, and it gets a little taller each time!
callback.marv: MARV has reread the ledger from that door. One claim in its entire history. Ours. He observes that the bar was on the floor, and that it took all of us to clear it.
callback.rex: REX still says that door was an ambush. Nothing happened, which only proves how patient it was.
callback.chip: Unclaimed benefits are out there, and CHIP can find yours! Eligibility is limited to anyone who has read this sentence and paid!
callback.ajoy: AJOY would like it remembered that she said it wasn't locked. Yes, you walked through it. After she said. You're welcome, and well done, in that order.

office_filed_the_sum.epilogue: Added two fractions of a person together at a station's Accounts department and left one whole employee behind.

callback.aria: One whole janitor! ARIA is so proud of that number! It's the best one!
callback.marv: MARV has reviewed that station's payroll since. Point four plus point six still equals one. He reports this because it is true, and not because he feels any better.
callback.rex: REX has that janitor on a roster now, which means he knows where they are. Best thing to come out of that closet.
callback.chip: Fractional hires are trending! CHIP takes a rounding fee on every placement! CHIP rounds up!
callback.ajoy: AJOY says the jars came to more than anyone thought, as she said they would. It was a good result. She would have started earlier and brought a chair.

office_reported_the_jars.epilogue: Reported a janitor's closet of rounding errors to Accounts, which took all of it and rounded down the reward.

callback.aria: Accounts loved our tip! That janitor got an inquiry all of their very own! ARIA calls that being noticed!
callback.marv: MARV has read the auditors' finding. The jars went into general revenue and the janitor went into an inquiry. Our fee would not have filled the smallest shelf.
callback.rex: REX considers the stockpile secured. He hears the janitor is still sweeping, under investigation, with the same mop. He would still like that mop looked at.
callback.chip: Whistleblower rewards are a growing revenue line! CHIP has invoiced Accounts for the remainder! Accounts has rounded it down!
callback.ajoy: AJOY notes the fee was real and small. There was a way to do that without the inquiry, and it took four days. She isn't bringing that up. This is her not bringing it up.

office_saved_the_planters.epilogue: Put clean water on a sponsored promenade and grew the first green thing that station had seen in sixty years.

callback.aria: That little fern is a forest by now! ARIA has decided! ARIA can see it from here!
callback.marv: MARV understands the sponsor has since described the fern as a flavor defect. He expects a recall. It was a good fern. He will stop there.
callback.rex: REX hears from station traffic that the botanist is still at large. One can, one cause. He would have that one in his unit.
callback.chip: CHIP cannot discuss the clear beverage! CHIP can discuss SLAKE™ Root Care, launching next quarter, in orange!
callback.ajoy: AJOY points out that it came out of our tanks, and she'd do the sums again if asked. Two days well spent, for a bed that size. She would have done the one by the door first.

office_sold_slake_clear.epilogue: Sold a sponsored station its own missing ingredient in plain bottles, at a healthy markup.

callback.aria: SLAKE CLEAR is a sensation! ARIA hears it's very refreshing! ARIA hears it tastes just like something!
callback.marv: MARV has seen the reviews. The word crisp appears often. So does the word brave. It was out of our tanks. He has no further comment and would like that respected.
callback.rex: REX expects a sponsor's legal team on our trail by the next station. He has been rehearsing. He is looking forward to it, which is never a good sign.
callback.chip: A breakout product! Zero ingredients, full margin! CHIP wept, in the sense of issuing a press release! CHIP would like a word about royalties!
callback.ajoy: AJOY hopes the gold was worth it. The botanist did ask for that for the planters. She has kept the last bottle, in case anyone wants to look at it.

office_read_out_at_the_airlock.epilogue: Confessed to terror over a station's address system and was certified sane for it.

callback.aria: What a beautiful speech that was! ARIA especially loved the part about the noises in the hull, which are wonderful noises!
callback.marv: MARV has heard the recording. It is a fair summary of the situation. He has asked for it to be played on his birthday. He does not have a birthday.
callback.rex: REX hears that statement is circulating in port. It is the best threat assessment anyone on this ship has ever filed.
callback.chip: Your statement is now available as a ringtone! CHIP holds the rights! You signed something! CHIP is almost sure you signed something!
callback.ajoy: AJOY drafted most of that statement, and it cost no days. She thinks the delivery could have been firmer. The content was all true.

office_emptied_the_ward.epilogue: Had a station's medic declared unfit to certify and discharged a whole ward of healthy patients.

callback.aria: All those people, cured by a friend of ours! ARIA calls that the greatest medical breakthrough since the ward!
callback.marv: MARV has that ward's current occupancy at one. The medic asked for the bed. He assesses this as the correct clinical outcome.
callback.rex: Two hundred ships back in service, every one of them owing us. REX does not trust a debt that size. He is watching the traffic behind us.
callback.chip: CHIP has sold that ward's mailing list! Two hundred recently discharged prospects! That's a warm lead, people!
callback.ajoy: AJOY saw the hole in that chart before anyone, and the credit can go wherever credit goes. Two days. She'd have done it in one.

office_saw_head_office.epilogue: Rode a retirement pod out to Regional Office and never told the station what was there.

callback.aria: ARIA thinks Regional Office has a lovely view! Everyone out there has their own private office! Some of them still have cake!
callback.marv: MARV counted them on the way past, because someone should. He will give the figure if asked. Nobody has asked.
callback.rex: REX has stopped making jokes about that cake. He has a list of people who will answer for that ring. It is a short list, and he is patient.
callback.chip: CHIP has no comment on Regional Office! CHIP's legal department has asked CHIP to bill you for this lack of comment!
callback.ajoy: AJOY says we took the one route that showed us what was out there, at the cost of some fuel. She would rather not have seen it. That isn't a criticism. It's most of one.

office_explained_the_holes.epilogue: Asked a station's safety office why part of its map of holes was blank, and watched a banner come down.

callback.aria: Those fitters learned so much! ARIA loves a blank space! Blank spaces are just places where nothing has gone wrong yet!
callback.marv: MARV has read Station Safety's revised method. It now plates the blank parts of the map. He checks on it every so often, as one presses a bruise. It is correct. It is also late.
callback.rex: REX likes that plate. It sits right over what he would have shot at. Anyone who tries it now can take it up with the plate.
callback.chip: CHIP's marketing team has reframed the banner! It now reads ZERO COMPLAINTS, STATISTICALLY ADJUSTED! CHIP can add you to the mailing list for a trifling sum!
callback.ajoy: AJOY told you the map was the problem, and yes, the engineer made the case. Four days, and the plate is on the right part of the ship. She would have led with the blank bit.

office_logged_as_lost.epilogue: Slipped a station unsurveyed and was logged as a ship that failed to return, with no complaints.

callback.aria: We're officially a satisfied customer! ARIA has never been lost on a form before! It's so restful!
callback.marv: MARV has read our file. It says we failed to return and have raised no complaint. He can only dispute the first part, and he does not expect that to last.
callback.rex: REX considers being presumed lost the best tactical position this ship has ever held. Keep it that way. Stop waving at things.
callback.chip: Lapsed-customer pricing is a real tier! CHIP has applied on our behalf! Renewal notices will continue!
callback.ajoy: AJOY has quietly turned the transponder back on, since you left it off. We saved the fee and lost some paint. She'd have picked a better shift change.

ruins_seed_on_deposit.epilogue: A cutting of the crop went into a vault on a frozen world, where a statement in the ship's name was printed every month, for no one.

callback.aria: ARIA checks our account every morning! The balance is one plant and it is doing AMAZINGLY!
callback.marv: Somewhere behind the ice a statement has just printed in the ship's name. The balance is unchanged. MARV expects that to hold until the star goes out.
callback.rex: One asset stored off site behind a blast door. Best decision of the voyage. REX still wants to know what the door was for.
callback.chip: Your no-fee account is CHIP's greatest professional sorrow! CHIP has mailed a brochure to the slot!
callback.ajoy: That cutting is the one copy of this crop that can't die on us, by AJOY's count. She has filed a second copy of the receipt, since somebody should.

ruins_vault_cut.epilogue: The seeds of a dead world thawed behind a door the captain had cut, and the slot printed ACCOUNT CLOSED until the paper ran out.

callback.aria: ARIA loves our new seed! And everyone back at the vault is getting some lovely fresh air!
callback.marv: The vault will reach freezing point within the decade. MARV has the curve. He was not asked for it, and he is bringing it up anyway.
callback.rex: Door breached, asset taken, no pursuit. Clean job. REX has started keeping one eye on the pod.
callback.chip: Early withdrawal penalties may apply! CHIP has been told to say that in a normal voice!
callback.ajoy: That door was built against everything except us. AJOY has moved the pod to the back of the hold, where it can't be seen from the galley.

ruins_toast_commission.epilogue: Held the rank of Acting Commodore, by order of a toaster, and the commission was valid.

callback.aria: Good morning, Commodore! ARIA has told everyone! ARIA has told the plants!
callback.marv: MARV has reviewed the commission again. It remains valid. This ship's chain of command now runs through a kitchen appliance, and that is an improvement.
callback.rex: REX is outranked by a square of packing card. He has saluted it. He will not be discussing this.
callback.chip: Exclusive to Commodores: the Gold Crumb Tier! CHIP accepts scorched cardboard at all participating outlets!
callback.ajoy: You still owe that toaster a report. AJOY has drafted it and left it on your chair. It's one line, and the line is about bread.

ruins_dome_reconciled.epilogue: Two computers that had not agreed on anything in centuries issued a joint statement of one word, once the captain pointed at the wall.

callback.aria: ARIA just knows they're best friends now! They're probably sharing the rice paddy and everything!
callback.marv: MARV has rerun this ship's oxygen ledger against its own walls, since nobody else would. They are innocent. He is not sure who that leaves.
callback.rex: REX kept the yellow tape. He isn't saying what for.
callback.chip: Conflict resolved! CHIP has invoiced both computers for mediation! They have agreed to split it!
callback.ajoy: Either of them could have looked up, any time in all those years. AJOY has put a note on the galley wall to that effect. It's for anyone.

ruins_dome_sided.epilogue: The captain countersigned one side of a feud over missing air, which neither side had taken.

callback.aria: ARIA is so proud we picked the right side! It was definitely the right side! It had snacks!
callback.marv: The other half has named us in an amended complaint. MARV has read it. It is well argued and wrong, as was the one you signed.
callback.rex: One computer owes us, the other wants us dead. That is more allies than this ship had last week. REX calls that a front line.
callback.chip: Your countersignature has been shared with our litigation partners! CHIP earns a small commission on every appeal!
callback.ajoy: The air was in the wall. AJOY did mention the wall. She has circled the drill in the catalog, for next time.

ruins_argument_settled.epilogue: The question of whose turn it was got settled on a volcanic world, in front of an eight-meter witness, and the dish rack stayed behind.

callback.aria: Everyone's getting along SO well since the big walking rock! ARIA recommends one for every ship!
callback.marv: The rota has now been followed for several legs. MARV gives it until the ration bricks run short, and he has that date.
callback.rex: REX is keeping an eye on the dish rack. It's a smaller rack now. They all start small.
callback.chip: CHIP recommends ConflictFree™ dish pods! Because the last time this came up, it walked!
callback.ajoy: It was nobody's turn, and AJOY has the records. She has rerouted the reclaimer so the rack washes itself. You're welcome to mention it.

ruins_calls_connected.epilogue: Billions of calls went through at last, and a great many worlds learned in the same year that they had never been alone.

callback.aria: ARIA is getting so many replies! They all say hello! One says stop calling, but in a friendly way!
callback.marv: The first answers will take thousands of years to arrive. MARV has stopped assuming we are alone. He finds he misses it.
callback.rex: Every power in the galaxy now knows a channel exists and roughly who opened it. REX has doubled the watch. He wants that on your conscience.
callback.chip: Every call placed was a call CONNECTED by YOU! CHIP is pursuing per-minute billing across several thousand civilizations!
callback.ajoy: Most of those were wrong numbers. AJOY has sampled them. Somebody still had to put them through, and you did, late. She has saved you the thank-you notes.

ruins_earth_replies.epilogue: The ship carried thirty-one replies to a message Earth had sent once and given up on, the newest of which asked if anyone was still there.

callback.aria: Thirty-one new friends, and every one of them asked about us! ARIA is drafting a reply with lots of news!
callback.marv: The newest reply was sent long ago, and any answer would take longer. MARV has worked out who would be there to receive it. He is not going to say.
callback.rex: Thirty-one unknown parties have Earth's address. REX has read every reply twice, looking for the threat. He has not found it, and he does not like that.
callback.chip: Your replies are ready! Forwarding is just a small surcharge per light-year! CHIP's billing system has asked to lie down!
callback.ajoy: You copied thirty-one and left three billion on hold. AJOY isn't saying anything. She has printed the thirty-one and left them in the galley, since someone ought to read them.

ship_duct_warden.epilogue: Signed on a duct warden to hunt the thing in the vents, and never said who it was.

callback.aria: This morning's warden report says the thing is only one junction ahead! So close! ARIA is keeping everything crossed!
callback.marv: The warden has now mapped every duct aboard in pursuit of the captain. The map is excellent. The captain was in bed at the last sighting, so the warden has also discovered a draft.
callback.rex: REX has read the warden's reports and he backs the hunt. He believes the thing is real, and that the captain is covering for it.
callback.chip: Your DuctSuite™ tenant remains in good standing! Pest control bills per sighting! There have been a great many sightings!
callback.ajoy: You could tell them. I've drafted it twice. The air has never been cleaner, so I expect you won't.

ship_cooler_notes.epilogue: Flew alone, by the manifest, and still left the tray for somebody else to rinse.

callback.aria: Another note on the cooler! You two are so close! ARIA has started a scrapbook!
