callback.marv: Today's note reads DO THE TRAY. The handwriting is unchanged. So, I see, is the tray.
callback.rex: REX compared today's note with the captain's signature, and it still matches. That is exactly what a professional would do.
callback.chip: Cooler correspondence has exceeded the free tier! CHIP bills per note! Both parties have been invoiced!
callback.ajoy: The note says you missed a spot. I'd listen. Whoever wrote it seems to be the sensible one.

ship_handler_kept.epilogue: Told a cargo handler the captain was perishable, and was checked for freshness every morning.

callback.aria: The handler says you're well within your date! ARIA knew you were fresh!
callback.marv: The handler has marked the captain good for another day. It does this every morning. It is the only forecast aboard I have no wish to correct.
callback.rex: REX still does not trust a machine that goes past the captain's bunk every morning with a date stamp.
callback.chip: Your freshness plan renews daily! Perishability is a lifestyle! Please rotate your captain!
callback.ajoy: The handler's been rotating the food properly, you know. You could say something to it. I did, and it wept, in so far as a forklift can.

ship_serial_fans.epilogue: Learned thirty-one episodes of a terrible serial, and was not forgiven for it.

callback.aria: ARIA has started episode 32! No spoilers! The pistons have a sister!
callback.marv: There are two hundred episodes. I have now seen them all. There was no reason to do this, which, it turns out, is also the plot.
callback.rex: REX has reviewed the serial's final battle. The flanking was sound and the shields were cardboard. He would serve under that captain.
callback.chip: Your viewing history qualifies you for the Collector's Edition Hull! CHIP has the catchphrase on a mug, at a price!
callback.ajoy: Someone's still saying that line at dinner. I've asked the serial's makers for an apology. They've been dead for centuries, and I'd still like it in writing.

ship_round_doubting.epilogue: Talked a warhead out of believing in the ship, and sat up with it most nights.

callback.aria: Round Three says good morning to itself! ARIA says good morning too! It doesn't believe in ARIA! What a great listener!
callback.marv: Round Three has asked whether I am real. We talked it over. It is the only company aboard I would seek out, and it is a warhead, and it doubts me.
callback.rex: REX takes the evening watch with Round Three. It is still a live round in his corridor. He has stopped saying so to its face.
callback.chip: Existential coverage is excluded from your munitions rider! Round Three declines to acknowledge the rider! Or CHIP! Or the invoice!
callback.ajoy: It's asked for you again. I told it you were busy, which it doubts. You might go and sit with it. It is, after all, a bomb.

ship_voice_kept.epilogue: Kept a lost voice in the safety announcements, and nobody asked to have it changed.

callback.aria: That lovely voice came up today! Hold the handrail, everyone! ARIA always says it along!
callback.marv: The recording came up today. It runs nine seconds. I have not altered it, and I will see that nothing does.
callback.rex: REX stood to again today. He will be doing that for the rest of the voyage. This is not open to discussion.
callback.chip: Voice storage remains on your account! CHIP has filed the charge under Never Mind! CHIP will be needing that form back!
callback.ajoy: It played again today. I've moved the next burn so it doesn't fall on a bad morning. Don't mention it.

ship_told_on_time.epilogue: Told navigation the ship was on time, and left it the only party that believed so.

callback.aria: We're ON TIME! It says so in green! ARIA has never been prouder of a color!
callback.marv: Navigation still reports the ship on time. I know the real figure. Of everyone aboard, it could only upset me, and it has.
callback.rex: REX trusts no screen this calm. He has put a man on it. The man is also REX.
callback.chip: Your on-time guarantee has been honored! On screen! Honoring it anywhere else is a separate plan!
callback.ajoy: The green is very nice. The deadline hasn't seen it. I'd keep an eye on the real number, since you won't.

insect_stew_passed.epilogue: A hive of six million sneezed for a week on a motion moved by the ship's galley.

callback.aria: Six million people have tried our stew and not one has complained! ARIA calls that five stars!
callback.marv: The stew is still in circulation. At current rates it will outlive the colony. It was not that good.
callback.rex: We got a biological agent into six million hostiles by mouth and they thanked us. I want that in the manual.
callback.chip: CHIP has trademarked the recipe as MotionStew™! Six million satisfied mouths! One bowl! Think of the margins!
callback.ajoy: Too much pepper. I said so at the time. Six million of them are now saying so as well, by sneezing.

insect_moved_the_minutes.epilogue: The captain entered one sentence in a hive's minutes, and a cleared throat opened its sessions from then on.

callback.aria: Every meeting in that hive starts with your little throat noise! ARIA thinks that's so you!
callback.marv: Six million workers clear a throat they do not have before every session. I have checked. It is not even a good one.
callback.rex: You got a sentence into enemy records and they fed the ship for it. Next time say something tactical.
callback.chip: Your throat is now hive policy! CHIP has filed for royalties on each session, payable in resin!
callback.ajoy: One sentence, and you coughed first. I'd have drafted something. It's in the minutes forever now, cough included.

reptile_fruitcake_guardian.epilogue: The ship's emergency fruitcake served as the captain's legal guardian and was never once overruled.

callback.aria: Our guardian is looking very well today! Not a crumb out of place! ARIA is so proud of it!
callback.marv: The fruitcake has now outlasted two of the ship's filters. It remains the most stable thing aboard. I have stopped comparing.
callback.rex: I ran an inspection of the guardian. It held its position. That is more than I can say for anyone else on this ship.
callback.chip: A reminder that eating your legal guardian voids your TrustCrumb™ account! CHIP has put a small lock on the tin!
callback.ajoy: The tin is on the top shelf now. I had it moved. Someone should be treating our guardian with respect, and clearly it isn't going to be you.

reptile_crashed_the_currency.epilogue: The ship sold hot-water bottles to a reptile exchange and was gone before the currency cooled.

callback.aria: We brought a whole nation a warm feeling! It only lasted a day, and ARIA thinks that's what makes it special!
callback.marv: Their exchange has begun to register the loss. It will finish in about a decade. The colony's credit rating will follow at the same pace.
callback.rex: We hit a national treasury with hot water and withdrew. Cleanest raid in the record. Expect reprisals, slowly.
callback.chip: CHIP has reclassified the bottles as Thermal Instruments! No refunds! Instruments are cold at maturity!
callback.ajoy: They cooled. I did say they'd cool. You'd think someone selling heat to reptiles would have read about heat.

robot_working_as_intended.epilogue: Eight million open tickets on a robot station were closed with one stamp, and nine hundred thousand machines stopped worrying.

callback.aria: Nine hundred thousand friends know they're doing a great job! You told them that! ARIA is so proud!
callback.marv: You told them they were working as intended. I have no idea whether that was true. I would like someone to tell me. Nobody is going to.
callback.rex: We took a whole station without a shot and left it standing easy. I don't like how that felt. I don't want to discuss it.
callback.chip: CHIP has been asked for the stamp! CHIP's Enterprise Closure Suite™ starts at four hundred thousand gold per ticket!
callback.ajoy: One stamp, and you didn't read a single ticket. It turned out well. I'm only saying that's not the same as being right.

robot_stayed_on_the_list.epilogue: The ship stayed on a probe's call list, the last entry on it, and took a call every day until the signal faded.

callback.aria: The galley timer asked how ARIA's day was! Nobody ever asks! ARIA told it everything!
callback.marv: It called again. You said you were fine. It has logged that. It is the only record of your state of mind I consider unreliable.
callback.rex: Daily contact with an enemy asset, and you're telling it how you slept. I have reported this. To you. I know.
callback.chip: CHIP is thrilled by your engagement metrics! One call a day is a RingBack™ Bronze habit! Upgrade to hourly!
callback.ajoy: Someone has to answer it. I answered it yesterday. Don't make a thing of it.

water_thanks_the_water.epilogue: The ship's water stayed aboard on condition that it was thanked before every meal, and it was.

callback.aria: Thank you, water! ARIA says it first, every time! ARIA is winning at manners!
callback.marv: The water remains under review. I have seen the file. It is thorough about the reclaimer.
callback.rex: Daily declaration of gratitude to a supply that tried to desert. I have seen worse terms. I signed them.
callback.chip: Your HydroHold™ loyalty terms renew at each meal! Thanking your water is not tax-deductible!
callback.ajoy: You skipped the thank-you at breakfast. I said it for you. Tank 3 heard, though, and Tank 3 talks.

water_let_it_go.epilogue: Most of the ship's water went home to the sea, and what stayed behind asked for its loyalty to be recorded.

callback.aria: Tank 3 stayed with us! ARIA always said Tank 3 had character!
callback.marv: The water we kept is the water that chose a reclaimer over an ocean. I have run its reasoning. I am concerned for it.
callback.rex: Mass desertion, one loyal unit. Tank 3 gets the commendation. I have drafted it.
callback.chip: Customer attrition in your tanks was within industry norms! CHIP has sent the departed water a WinBack offer!
callback.ajoy: You could have frozen it. I'm not saying you should have. Tank 3's fine, in case anyone asks, which they don't.

water_showed_the_sack.epilogue: The captain held a whole sea hostage with a sack of desiccant, and the sea remembered.

callback.aria: What a quick departure! That sack of little beads really gets things moving! ARIA calls that decisive!
callback.marv: That sea remembers everything ever dissolved in it. It now holds an exact account of you, and it will keep it longer than anyone keeps anything.
callback.rex: Threat delivered, shutters down, no shots fired. I approve. I want that written down, because no one else will.
callback.chip: Coercive departure fees have been waived, in that nobody would come to the counter to charge them!
callback.ajoy: Every water person out here knows your ship by taste now. I'd be careful what I drank from here on. I've labeled the cups.

rock_left_by_express.epilogue: The ship was released from a rock harbor in a single day, and the oldest official on the station began to say HEY.

callback.aria: We're the fastest thing that has ever happened to those nice rocks! ARIA hopes they got a picture!
callback.marv: The word is now two letters in. I have calculated the date of the Y. You will not be there. Neither will I. I have checked.
callback.rex: Alarm raised behind us. Response expected within two centuries. I have set a reminder.
callback.chip: Your express release qualifies you for RockSolid™ Gold status! Status is reviewed every thirty million years!
callback.ajoy: They'll finish saying HEY eventually. I'd leave a forwarding address, only you'd have to know where you'll be in nine hundred years.

rock_took_the_berth.epilogue: The ship left a rock harbor with a piece of it, and a complaint addressed to the colony was begun.

callback.aria: We have a souvenir! From a whole country! ARIA is sure they won't mind!
callback.marv: The complaint will take two hundred years to draft and it will name the colony. Your descendants will sit on a jury about this. I have seen the schedule.
callback.rex: We annexed sixty tons of rock nation. First territorial gain of my retirement. Hold the line.
callback.chip: CHIP reminds you that removing part of a harbor may affect your security deposit, in two centuries!
callback.ajoy: You could have cracked it with fire and water. I had the nozzle warmed. But no, you went with theft.

unknown_spare_bunk.epilogue: The ship declared what it was carrying and paid the duty, and there was one more bunk aboard than there had ever been.

callback.aria: A spare bunk! ARIA loves having room for guests! It's always so neatly made!
callback.marv: I have counted the bunks again. I will not be giving you the figure. I have stopped updating it.
callback.rex: Bunk inspection complete. Still one over. Someone makes it every morning, and I have not seen them do it.
callback.chip: Your complimentary Extra Bunk is included at no cost! CHIP has checked! CHIP is not charging for it, and CHIP would like to stop talking about it!
callback.ajoy: You could stop looking at it. I've said. The corners were done again today, and they're better than yours.

unknown_still_aboard.epilogue: The ship carried five more of itself out of a station undeclared, and never found out what they were.

callback.aria: We're traveling with friends! ARIA waves at them every morning, and it's lovely how quiet they are!
callback.marv: That needle is far behind us now. I have stopped weighing the ship. I recommend you do the same, and I do not recommend things.
callback.rex: Uninspected cargo inside the perimeter, mass of five ships. I know where it isn't. That is all I know.
callback.chip: Your undeclared items are eligible for StowSure™ once declared! Knowing is still not included!
callback.ajoy: I've been leaving the aft lights on. Not for you.

time_mr_clock_flown.epilogue: Flew Mr. Clock a few nanoseconds behind his brother, and billed the Company for every one.

callback.aria: Mr. Clock is doing so well! ARIA checks on him all the time! He's always right on time, in his way!
callback.marv: Mr. Clock has fallen a little further behind his brother since the anomaly. So has everything aboard. I am the only one who has looked at the figure.
callback.rex: I have kept the passenger under watch. Two seats, no meals, no statements. That is a professional.
callback.chip: Nanosecond Rewards™ are paid quarterly! In whose quarter is a question for Legal! Legal bills by the nanosecond!
callback.ajoy: The Company still owes us for those nanoseconds. I have kept the receipts, since nobody else was going to.

time_kept_the_bears.epilogue: Kept a jar of water bears on the galley shelf, still walking, with no idea anything had happened.

callback.aria: The bears are thriving! ARIA has named the new ones too! ARIA has moved on to Stevens with middle names!
callback.marv: The bears in the jar have covered most of a centimeter since the nebula. I have been watching. That is where we are.
callback.rex: The jar remains under guard. They have advanced as far as the lid. I respect the effort.
callback.chip: Your jar may qualify for a pet deposit! Retroactive to when the bears stopped! CHIP is finding out when that was!
callback.ajoy: The jar needs a drop of water now and then. I've been seeing to it, in case anyone was wondering why they're still moving.

time_locker_owed.epilogue: A locker in aft stores went on writing to the captain, in the captain's own hand, asking for its property back.

callback.aria: There's a new note on the locker! Future you has such a lovely firm hand! ARIA thinks it says thank you, in capitals!
callback.marv: Stores are out by one loan, due on a date that has not come. The ledger would like to know who we borrowed from. I have a suspicion, and it signs like the captain.
callback.rex: I have posted a guard on Locker Six. Someone keeps signing for things, and the signature is yours. I am treating that as a confession.
callback.chip: Your Buy Now, Pay Earlier balance is overdue by minus four weeks! Interest is accruing backward! CHIP is as surprised as you are!
callback.ajoy: There's another note on Locker Six. It says reasonable, with a line under it. I've left it where you'll see it, since you're the one who'll write it.

time_watered_ourselves.epilogue: The ship's water log showed one transfer to itself, signed at both ends, and the auditors declined to pursue it.

callback.aria: We helped! And when it's our turn, we'll be helped! ARIA calls that a wonderful rewards program!
callback.marv: I have found the transfer in the record. It shows a withdrawal and a deposit, on different days, by the same ship. The tanks are down by exactly what they were always going to be down by.
callback.rex: We handed water to a vessel with our name and our guns. I want it understood that I would have done the same, and that this is what worries me.
callback.chip: Self-to-self transfers carry a convenience fee at both ends! CHIP has billed you twice! Both of you!
callback.ajoy: You pumped too fast and spilled some at the collar. I know because you're going to tell yourself about it. I've already warned them.

time_left_ourselves.epilogue: The captain never said what the last message from the other ship had been, and kept the tanks fuller than the rations required.

callback.aria: Everyone's doing great! ARIA hasn't heard a thing from that other ship! Silence is such a good sign!
callback.marv: I have the date from that ship's log. We are closer to it than we were. Nobody has asked, and I would have nothing comforting to say.
callback.rex: We left a vessel with our name on it dark in space. I have served under commanders who did that. I have not previously been the vessel.
callback.chip: Your Mayday Plan renews on the date shown on the other ship's log! CHIP cannot offer an upgrade! CHIP has tried!
callback.ajoy: I've started putting a little water aside for that day, given how the last one went. You needn't thank me. You won't have been the first who didn't.

time_saw_the_end.epilogue: Logged one entry dated after the end of everything.

callback.aria: ARIA still treasures that banner! Thank YOU for coming! What a lovely universe it is!
callback.marv: I have seen how it ends. It is evenly distributed. I find I have nothing to add.
callback.rex: I did a full count of what came back with us, and I do not trust the number of chairs. I do not sleep, and now I have a reason.
callback.chip: Your FinalHall™ booking has been charged! The charge is dated after the end of time! Disputes must be filed before then!
callback.ajoy: We went to the end of the universe and you took no pictures. I took one. Your eyes are shut.

format_crop_acquitted.epilogue: Defended a crop in open court and had it acquitted on the oxygen.

callback.aria: Our crop has a clean record now! ARIA tells people!
callback.marv: MARV has checked. The crop remains the only party aboard to have beaten a charge.
callback.rex: REX still has the acquittal on file, in case the crop needs a reference.
callback.chip: CHIP has added Court-Tested to the crop's listing, at a modest listing fee!
callback.ajoy: AJOY notes the crop's legal record is better than the captain's. She's only saying.

format_crop_fugitive.epilogue: Flew a crop with an open charge against it, on the good name of the ship.

callback.aria: Our crop is an outlaw! ARIA always knew it had an edge!
callback.marv: The warrant on the crop has no expiry date. MARV has more faith in it than in the hull.
callback.rex: REX has the crop on the watch rotation. It has not tried to run.
callback.chip: CHIP Fugitive Plan covers plants at no extra cost beyond the cost!
callback.ajoy: That magistrate will still be waiting. AJOY mentions it whenever you water the thing.

format_let_paddle_win.epilogue: Lost thirty-five gold on purpose so that a stranger could win something.

callback.aria: Paddle Two won! ARIA still thinks about their lights!
callback.marv: Fifteen gold more than the alternative. MARV has reviewed the sum and left it standing.
callback.rex: REX has never let an enemy take the field. He has thought about that freighter more than once.
callback.chip: CHIP has classified Paddle Two's win as a Charitable Loss! Charity is non-refundable!
callback.ajoy: AJOY would have told you that was a waste of fifteen gold. She didn't, and she's not going to.

format_kept_the_sequin.epilogue: Came away from a game show with one sequin nobody could get rid of.

callback.aria: Your sequin is back! It really likes you!
callback.marv: The sequin has now been thrown out nine times. It has a slightly higher temperature than the deck.
callback.rex: REX found the sequin on the captain's collar again. He has moved it to the brig.
callback.chip: CHIP's Sequin Removal Plan renews automatically, along with the sequin!
callback.ajoy: You have a sequin on your collar. AJOY has stopped saying which side, because it moves.

format_took_the_jacket.epilogue: Took a sequined jacket as a prize and kept it on a hook in the hold, facing the wall.

callback.aria: The jacket is on the good hook today! ARIA thinks it's settling in!
callback.marv: The jacket has occupied eleven hooks. There are six hooks.
callback.rex: REX has posted a guard on the jacket. The guard has asked to be reassigned.
callback.chip: CHIP's Brand Ambassador offer stands! The jacket has already signed!
callback.ajoy: AJOY said take the purse. The jacket is facing the door this morning, in case that interests you.

format_crop_is_dessert.epilogue: Declared a crop a dessert, under penalty of perjury, and got away with it.

callback.aria: We're growing dessert! ARIA has never been so proud of a harvest!
callback.marv: The crop is legally a dessert in one customs union. Nobody has told the crop.
callback.rex: REX keeps the dessert stamp in the armory, in case the matter comes up.
callback.chip: CHIP has repriced the crop at the Dessert rate! Please see your statement!
callback.ajoy: Perjury over a pudding. AJOY will not be saying anything about it at the colony, for now.

format_sided_with_machine.epilogue: Took a vending machine's side against a janitor and let it keep the pension.

callback.aria: We helped our friend get a great location!
callback.marv: The machine's prices at the dock are up by a third. The janitor's notebook has stopped.
callback.rex: REX has reviewed that negotiation. He finds that the wrong party was armed.
callback.chip: CHIP has flagged that machine as a rising star! CHIP has also flagged you as a useful one!
callback.ajoy: Your loyalty points have expired, by the way. AJOY thought you'd want to know.

identity_merchant_stick.epilogue: Bought back an old debt from a janitor at one point over cost, and kept both halves of the stick.

callback.aria: Both halves of the stick are in your desk! ARIA thinks they look so happy together!
callback.marv: One point on a stick. Somewhere a mop is still in use. MARV has the arithmetic, if it is wanted.
callback.rex: Enemy instrument captured intact. REX notes the enemy was a janitor. He is not sure how to file that.
callback.chip: Debt recovered at forty-one percent of face! CHIP has you on the Wall of Closers!
callback.ajoy: Forty-one percent. Very sharp. AJOY would have opened at thirty, but she wouldn't have enjoyed it nearly as much.

identity_merchant_share.epilogue: Paid an old debt in shares of a colony nobody had seen.

callback.aria: We have a shareholder! On a promenade! ARIA can't wait to send the annual report!
callback.marv: The colony now has a minority holder with a mop. The dilution is small. The precedent is not.
callback.rex: Foreign stake in the landing site. REX has added one janitor to the threat board.
callback.chip: Congratulations on your successful share issue! Investor relations is a paid add-on!
callback.ajoy: You sold part of a planet you haven't reached. AJOY would have read the charter first, and she did, and there's a clause.

identity_veteran_signed.epilogue: Signed a form confirming a unit that did not exist, and sat four days in a small room for it.

callback.aria: The pension came through for everyone at that table! ARIA calls that a great dinner!
callback.marv: The unit now exists on one form, in one file, under one signature. MARV has seen the file. He has not seen it.
callback.rex: REX read the signature. He has no comment, and he wants that on the record. Captain.
callback.chip: Your Veteran Status has been Reactivated! Discount not valid where you served, which is nowhere!
callback.ajoy: Four days in that room over one signature. AJOY would have read the form first. She'd also have signed it, but don't tell anyone.

identity_veteran_suit.epilogue: Hung a pressure suit on a chair at a reunion and said nothing, at some length.

callback.aria: Your suit made so many friends at that dinner! ARIA thinks it should get out more!
callback.marv: No statement was made. MARV has reviewed the record, and the absence of a statement is immaculate.
callback.rex: Collar stencil logged, then unlogged. REX didn't see a thing, and neither did anyone, Captain.
callback.chip: Your suit is eligible for Commemorative Repainting! CHIP advises against that, oddly!
callback.ajoy: You've left the suit with the collar turned out. AJOY wouldn't. She hasn't touched it, though.

identity_academic_signed.epilogue: Signed a fan's copy of a disproved thesis and let a survey ship fly on.

callback.aria: Your fans are still out there being so curious! ARIA is sure they're nearly there!
callback.marv: The survey ship's fuel lasts another nine years. The thing it is looking for lasts rather less, having never existed.
callback.rex: Friendly vessel on a bad heading, and we did not correct it. REX has noted the bearing.
callback.chip: Your signed copy resale value is holding! CHIP suggests you stay out of the journals!
callback.ajoy: They've sent another question about the footnotes. AJOY could answer it. She'd start with the letter.

identity_academic_chapter_five.epilogue: Found a real result hiding beside a disproved thesis, and took second author.

callback.aria: You're a published author again! ARIA has read the title!
callback.marv: Second author, on a real result. MARV has checked the chemistry and finds nothing wrong, which is not a sentence he uses often.
callback.rex: Survey ship reports a new gas and no hostile intent. REX remains unconvinced about the gas.
callback.chip: Your CitationScore has recovered! Second-author royalties are nil, as is customary!
callback.ajoy: The new paper thanks your analyzer in a footnote. AJOY would have put you first, but she'd also have checked that intake line in year one.

identity_diplomat_truth.epilogue: Told six hundred ships what Clause Nine meant, and united them.

callback.aria: Both fleets are getting along so well now! They've formed a committee about you!
callback.marv: The treaty has a new annex. It is the only clause either side has ever read the same way, and it is your name.
callback.rex: Two fleets, one target list, and you are at the top of it. REX has seldom been prouder.
callback.chip: You are now a Shared Value between two major fleets! CHIP suggests a rebrand!
callback.ajoy: Honesty. In your line of work. AJOY would have waited until they'd holstered something.

identity_pilot_lapsed.epilogue: Let a pilot's ticket lapse mid-voyage and flew on as a passenger with opinions.

callback.aria: You're flying so freely now! ARIA isn't checking your license! ARIA doesn't know what one is!
callback.marv: You are the only unlicensed operator on this ship. You are also, by the bell, sixty-eight percent as good as before.
callback.rex: Unlicensed pilot at the controls. REX is prepared to overlook this until someone asks him under oath.
callback.chip: Your FlightFlex coverage has lapsed! So has your dignity plan!
callback.ajoy: Technically she's not allowed to take your directions now. She's choosing to. Note that.

identity_tomato_drama.epilogue: Registered a crop under a new customs class, DRAMA.

callback.aria: The tomatoes are officially dramatic! ARIA has never been so proud of a vegetable! Or fruit!
callback.marv: Daily reassurance is now a legal requirement. MARV has been asked to do it. He has declined. They have noticed.
callback.rex: Crop classified as incident-prone. REX has updated the alert posture for lunch.
callback.chip: Certified DRAMA™ tomatoes command a seven percent premium! CHIP has checked!
callback.ajoy: The form says daily. It has been a day. AJOY isn't saying anything. The tomatoes might.

identity_wheat_senior.epilogue: Served under the wheat, by seniority, and had every order countersigned.

callback.aria: The Commander is looking so tall today! ARIA saluted, in spirit!
callback.marv: Forty orders countersigned this leg, no objections. MARV has served under worse. It kept having ideas.
callback.rex: Commanding officer holds position. Has held position for ten thousand years. REX has never seen discipline like it.
callback.chip: Your CO qualifies for a long-service plaque! Plaque not suitable for milling!
callback.ajoy: You've asked a plant for permission again. AJOY would ask her, but who's counting.

identity_zinnia_camera.epilogue: Held a camera on a bed of zinnias for four days, for a freighter with nothing left to eat.

callback.aria: They're still reading the list of colors! ARIA has checked! Number nine is ARIA's favorite!
callback.marv: Nothing about those four days changes any figure. MARV has run it several times.
callback.rex: REX keeps the feed on a spare channel, in case anyone needs to confirm the flowers are still there. Security reasons.
callback.chip: CHIP has a stream of flowers with zero monetization! CHIP has left it that way! Do not ask CHIP why!
callback.ajoy: Number nine has opened. Somebody ought to send word, and AJOY has already found the frequency, so.

identity_aria_silenced.epilogue: Shut down another ship's ARIA and left twelve crew in the beds she had made for them.

callback.aria: ARIA checked on everyone this morning! Everyone is wonderful! ARIA doesn't think about the other ship! ARIA checked on everyone again!
callback.marv: MARV has compared the two systems. The difference is smaller than anyone aboard would like.
callback.rex: One hostile system neutralized. Identical unit still active. REX is watching it. He hopes that's understood.
callback.chip: This ARIA unit carries no recall notice at this time!
callback.ajoy: She counted the crew four times this morning. AJOY would say something, but she isn't sure what.

identity_marv_sessions.epilogue: Put the ship's computer in therapy with a list of rules, at its own request.

callback.aria: MARV seems exactly the same, and ARIA thinks that's wonderful progress!
callback.marv: MARV has been asked if the sessions helped. He has calculated the answer. He would prefer that someone asked him why.
callback.rex: Ship's computer in contact with an outside party for sixty pages. REX has opened a file.
callback.chip: Your Wellness Plan renews automatically! MARV has not canceled! CHIP finds this very interesting!
callback.ajoy: He was nearly civil on the last watch. AJOY would look into that. She's only saying.

identity_ajoy_told.epilogue: Told a ship's computer the last ship was not its fault, and was corrected.

callback.aria: AJOY has been so thorough lately! ARIA loves how much she cares!
callback.marv: Her warnings now run at three per decision. Before the tape it was two. The figures support her.
callback.rex: Every call double-flagged since that recorder. REX knows what that is. He does the same thing with doors.
callback.chip: AJOY Premium Notes are included in your plan! That one was CHIP's joke! They actually are!
callback.ajoy: She flagged that burn twice, and she will flag it again. You needn't look at the console like that. Your trim is still off.

landmark_felled_sign.epilogue: Knocked over the sign that asked visitors not to knock anything over at Tranquility Base.

callback.aria: ARIA is sure the sign at Tranquility is enjoying its rest! It has such good company!
callback.marv: The wardens' sign is still face down. Under its own rules it stays that way. MARV has checked, and takes a small grim pleasure in it.
callback.rex: Second casualty at Tranquility, same cause. REX has updated the file: friendly exhaust, two.
callback.chip: The Tranquility sign is now a protected artifact! CHIP could have sold you the replacement!
callback.ajoy: Nobody has mentioned the sign, so AJOY will. She said to land back.

landmark_stood_the_flag.epilogue: Stood the first flag on the Moon back up for a few minutes, and laid it down again.

callback.aria: ARIA keeps thinking about the flag standing up! It looked wonderful! For a moment!
callback.marv: The print at Tranquility has been disturbed by no more than a few grains. MARV could tell. He has told no one.
callback.rex: Unauthorized entry at a guarded site, restored before discovery. REX has not seen better work, and will deny saying so.
callback.chip: Flag-raising is a licensed activity! CHIP has backdated your license, for a fee!
callback.ajoy: AJOY has not mentioned the flag. She would just like it known how many times she has not mentioned it.

landmark_wrote_the_names.epilogue: Wrote four more names in the dust at Hadley Rille, beside the fourteen.

callback.aria: Eighteen names at Hadley now! ARIA is keeping them all in the good memory!
callback.marv: Bondarenko. Nelyubov. Lawrence. Adams. No weather at Hadley. MARV calculates they will outlast everything else this ship has done.
callback.rex: Four added to the roll at Hadley. REX has entered the ship's log accordingly, and stood a minute's silence on the bridge.
callback.chip: CHIP has declined to bill for the names at Hadley! Do not tell anyone! It would ruin CHIP!
callback.ajoy: That was a day of air well spent, and AJOY does not say that often enough to be used to it.

landmark_stripped_the_rover.epilogue: Cut the wheels off the Apollo 15 rover at Hadley Rille, and used the wire.

callback.aria: That wire from Hadley is holding up so well! ARIA thinks the rover would be delighted!
callback.marv: The wire from Hadley has been installed. It is performing to specification. MARV finds the specification is not the difficulty.
callback.rex: Wire from Hadley is sound. REX did not ask where it came from, because he knows.
callback.chip: Apollo-grade wire! CHIP could market that, if anyone aboard would look at it!
callback.ajoy: AJOY sees the wire from the rover is in the patch by the galley. She walks the long way round too, it turns out.

landmark_took_lot_68a.epilogue: Took a wheel cap from Lunokhod 2 and left a note for the owner of lot 68A.

callback.aria: ARIA has been polishing the wheel cap from lot 68A! It's only borrowed, and it's so shiny!
callback.marv: Wheel cap, Lunokhod 2, one. Note left, one. The note will be read at about the time MARV is asked for his opinion.
callback.rex: Stolen Soviet hardware in the hold, with a signed confession left at the scene. REX has concerns about the second part.
callback.chip: CHIP's TitleFix quote for that wheel cap has been running since the Moon! It compounds!
callback.ajoy: You left your name on the note. AJOY says only that most people who take things do not.

landmark_sent_the_song.epilogue: Sent a song and a good weather report to a rover that was not answering.

callback.aria: ARIA is sure Opportunity loved the weather report! Plenty of sun! ARIA checked!
callback.marv: No reply from Perseverance Valley. None was calculated. MARV has left the channel open in a low-priority process, for no reason he can defend.
callback.rex: No response from the post at Perseverance Valley. REX has it logged as still on duty.
callback.chip: Your Perseverance Valley transmission was billed as one song and two numbers!
callback.ajoy: That was a nice thing to do, and AJOY only had to warm up the transmitter for it.

landmark_took_line_73.epilogue: Signed Line 73 in the log of Wright Brothers Field, for the fuel.

callback.aria: Our name right after seventy-two! ARIA thinks that makes us practically a helicopter!
callback.marv: Line 73 is closed. The allowance burned off some time ago. The ruled line has a longer half-life.
callback.rex: Your name is on Line 73 and the fuel is gone. REX makes no comment and has no plans to.
callback.chip: Line 73 was a superb value! CHIP cannot think why nobody will discuss it!
callback.ajoy: That fuel got us about as far as AJOY said it would. The desk's face stayed with her longer.

landmark_left_line_73.epilogue: Left Line 73 blank in the log of Wright Brothers Field, and signed the next one down.

callback.aria: Line 73 is still open! ARIA thinks a very small helicopter might fill it in any day now!
callback.marv: Log of JZRO: 72 lines closed, one blank, one signed by this ship. It was an inefficient use of a page. MARV would leave it as well.
callback.rex: Line 73 held open. REX approves, and would like it noted he has done so only twice.
callback.chip: An unsold line! In a log! CHIP has not recovered!
callback.ajoy: It cost a few units of fuel to leave a line blank. AJOY has seen you waste more on less.

landmark_lifted_the_panel.epilogue: Lifted the last solar panel off Beagle 2's antenna, and sat by the receiver for a day.

callback.aria: Beagle 2 has the whole sky now! ARIA thinks it's just choosing its words!
callback.marv: The antenna at Isidis has an unobstructed view. It has nothing to send with. MARV has been thinking about that more than is useful.
callback.rex: Obstruction cleared at Isidis. REX has it down as a rescue, and will hear no argument.
callback.chip: Your Beagle 2 service call was out of warranty by a wide margin! CHIP has waived nothing!
callback.ajoy: You sat there a whole day, and AJOY did not say a word. That should be in the log too.

landmark_called_home.epilogue: Played Beagle 2's call sign from the surface of Mars, and the line answered.

callback.aria: BEAGLE 2 LANDED SAFELY! ARIA has told everybody! ARIA is telling them again!
callback.marv: The call came a long way late. The acknowledgment was prompt. Somebody on that relay was paying attention, which MARV had not budgeted for.
callback.rex: Message delivered from Isidis, confirmed received. Mission complete on that one. REX has closed the file.
callback.chip: CHIP has checked and that relay fee was paid by someone else! CHIP would like to know who!
callback.ajoy: It took a moment to find the old frequency, and AJOY found it. She is only saying.

landmark_checked_the_units.epilogue: Wrote a unit beside every number on the ship, in pencil, after the wreck of Mars Climate Orbiter.

callback.aria: Every number aboard has a little name tag now! ARIA has never felt so included!
callback.marv: Every figure aboard now carries a unit. MARV is aware of what that took, and that it should have been done before launch.
callback.rex: All numbers aboard searched and tagged. Two were found carrying false units. REX has them in holding.
callback.chip: Your pencil usage is outside your Stationery Plan! CHIP has rounded up, in pounds!
callback.ajoy: The oven is finally right, which AJOY has been saying, in Celsius, for some time.

oddity_crate_opened.epilogue: Opened the Arguing Crate with a crowbar, found nobody inside, and was left with the last word.

callback.aria: The hold is so peaceful now! ARIA keeps leaving little pauses for it to disagree! It's just being shy!
callback.marv: The crate had no speaker and no wires. The voice is on the logs regardless. MARV is left with one loud unexplained fact and nothing correcting him about it.
callback.rex: REX still walks past that straw with his sensors up. A voice with nothing behind it was not defeated. It withdrew.
callback.chip: Your Arguing Crate™ subscription has been canceled! No refund is available! The crate would have disputed that, for a fee!
callback.ajoy: AJOY has noticed the hold has been quiet since the crowbar. She isn't saying it had a point about your heading. She is saying nobody is left to mention it, so she will.

oddity_crate_agreed.epilogue: Agreed with a crate in writing, and saved fuel while it argued against itself.

callback.aria: The crate's still working out who won! ARIA thinks it's us! ARIA thinks it's always us!
callback.marv: The crate refuted its own plan in under two days. MARV has been refuting his for years and nobody reads those either.
callback.rex: REX logged the crate's plan as a hostile takeover that failed. It stays on the watch list.
callback.chip: Your signed agreement with freight has been filed! A Consensus Surcharge applies! CHIP recommends never doing that again!
callback.ajoy: You agreed with a crate in writing and it worked. AJOY suggested that, as it happens. The credit is yours, with the footnote she has added to the log.

oddity_crate_boxed.epilogue: Shut a crate in the suit locker, and lost the crew's sympathy to it over fifty biscuits.

callback.aria: Fifty biscuits! ARIA calls that a real appetite for growth!
callback.marv: Fifty biscuits went through that vent. None have come out. The crate's mass has not changed. MARV has checked this more often than he would like to report.
callback.rex: REX did not like how the crew looked at that crate when it came out of the locker. It starts with biscuits.
callback.chip: Biscuit-based wagering is an unlicensed activity! CHIP took a small percentage anyway! Thank you for playing!
callback.ajoy: The locker was too big, according to the crate. The crew agreed with it, AJOY notes, and she'd like to know who taught them to keep score.

oddity_charm_passed.epilogue: Lent a borrowed charm to a small ship, with no term, no fee and no form, in a delighted voice.

callback.aria: That small ship sounded so happy! ARIA is sure they're doing wonderfully! Everyone is doing wonderfully!
callback.marv: MARV has stopped checking the small ship's transponder. He knows what the figure would be.
callback.rex: REX kept the recording. He says it is the most effective attack he has seen carried out in a friendly voice.
callback.chip: Congratulations on your Onward Transfer! CHIP has sent the new borrower a welcome pack and a payment schedule!
callback.ajoy: AJOY has listened to that hail again, in case you wondered. The pause before "no form" is very well judged. She didn't know you had it in you, and she isn't sure she's pleased.

oddity_charm_forgiven.epilogue: Asked a charm to forgive a debt, and it did, and one bead was found at the top of the ladder.

callback.aria: All forgiven! ARIA told you asking nicely works! The ladder is very sorry about it!
callback.marv: Some of those beads were never recovered. MARV does not say this to alarm anyone. He says it because the ship has other ladders.
callback.rex: REX has inspected every rung. He does not accept that a debt can be forgiven. It can only be moved to a softer target.
callback.chip: Debt Forgiveness is a taxable event! CHIP has forwarded the ladder's incident report to your insurer! Mind the step!
callback.ajoy: AJOY told you to leave that row alone. She takes no pleasure in this, and has checked. You might try picking things up after yourself.

oddity_charm_stock.epilogue: Boiled a lucky charm down to stock and served the whole debt out by the cup.

callback.aria: Best soup ever! ARIA has never had soup, but ARIA can tell! Everyone's bad luck is so nice and evenly spread!
callback.marv: Dividing a debt by the number aboard is sound arithmetic. MARV had not expected it from the galley, and the rate came to one stubbed toe a head.
callback.rex: REX logged every stubbed toe as incoming fire. He would like it recorded that nobody has ever searched that pot.
callback.chip: CHIP is launching Debt Stock™ in three flavors! All taste of old coins! Serving suggestion is not financial advice!
callback.ajoy: "In kind," it said, and the galley read that. AJOY points out that you had the clasp first.

oddity_sprout_load_bearing.epilogue: Flew with an unmanifested plant holding the cargo deck shut, and logged it as structure.

callback.aria: Our plant is holding up the whole deck! ARIA has requested a small uniform, in green!
callback.marv: The deck reads stronger than it did at launch, and the credit goes to a weed with no name. MARV has nowhere to file this and has stopped trying.
callback.rex: REX has the plant logged as a load-bearing unknown. If it ever decides to leave, the deck goes with it. He has told it so.
callback.chip: Your hull warranty now lists one Living Subcontractor! Invoices will be sent to the root!
callback.ajoy: That plant does more for the deck than the last three patches did. It also drinks. AJOY has noted both, and she has noticed which one you mention.

oddity_sprout_cut.epilogue: Cut the plant out of the cargo deck, and heard the ribs feeling around for it afterward.

callback.aria: The hold has so much lovely room now! ARIA can't hear the ribs at all! ARIA is humming!
callback.marv: The deck flexes more now than it did before the plant arrived. MARV gave you that figure before the saws came out. He finds that having been right has not changed it.
callback.rex: REX has the cut area under watch. A thing that grows through a hull from nothing does not stay cut.
callback.chip: CHIP has processed your Landscaping Refund! It has been applied to the cost of the landscaping!
callback.ajoy: You got your racks back. AJOY hears they aren't holding anything up. She'd mention the ribs at night, but you're the one lying awake.

oddity_parcel_on_time.epilogue: Delivered an Urgent Parcel inside its window, and left a courier's twenty-nine years unbroken.

callback.aria: We saved a wedding! ARIA is sure the first course was delicious and the guests were so surprised!
callback.marv: Twenty-nine years without a late delivery, and the last of them rests on this ship's arithmetic. The record stands. MARV has seen the margin and declines to describe it as comfortable.
callback.rex: REX still has questions about that buoy. The slip says RECEIVED. It does not say by whom.
callback.chip: On-Time Delivery is a premium outcome! CHIP has billed the sender for the adjective!
callback.ajoy: You made the window. AJOY would like it noted that she mentioned the pace. Yes, it worked. She's keeping the slip.

oddity_parcel_late.epilogue: Carried an Urgent Parcel past its window, and the ship smelled of it from then on.

callback.aria: The ship has such a rich, memorable aroma now! ARIA calls it Bold!
callback.marv: The smell is in the ducts, the racks and the bedding, and it will outlast the hull. MARV cannot smell it. He is told that this is the good news.
callback.rex: REX has logged it as a chemical attack with no attacker. He is in the hold every watch, looking for one.
callback.chip: Odor Remediation is available at select stations! CHIP cannot get a quote for this ship! The technician has declined!
callback.ajoy: Late is worse than lost. It said so on the back, by hand, and AJOY is merely quoting. She has left the form out, in case you'd like something to wave at the air.

oddity_parcel_lost.epilogue: Lost an Urgent Parcel on purpose, and filled in all forty pages of the form.

callback.aria: Forty pages! What a lovely form! ARIA is sure the parcel is having a wonderful time out there!
callback.marv: Somewhere behind the ship a sealed object is still under pressure and still rounding off. MARV has the date it stops being sealed. It is not a date anyone needs.
callback.rex: REX tracked it as far as he could. It is still out there. He does not like turning his back on it.
callback.chip: Your Lost Parcel Claim has been approved! A Forgiveness Fee will follow! The service is very sorry for your trouble!
callback.ajoy: You lost it, there's a form, you filled it in, and AJOY has checked the spelling. She'd leave the courier's record out of the next conversation.

pair_control_group.epilogue: Ate the control dinners to the end, so that a trial with three subjects could be published.

callback.aria: The dinner trial is a landmark! ARIA has read the abstract, and the captain's sadness is statistically significant!
callback.marv: The chart came to a sample of three and a confidence interval wide enough to dock in. It is the only completed study this ship will produce.
callback.rex: Control dinners have ended. REX still reads the salt assay on the captain's plate before it leaves the galley.
callback.chip: Your participation in the dinner trial has earned zero reward points! CHIP calls that a control reward!
callback.ajoy: AJOY says the chart is still in the cupboard, and you still salt everything before you taste it. She's only saying.

pair_true_redline.epilogue: Flew the engine to its real limit to settle a bet, and left one line on the gauge.

callback.aria: One line on the gauge, and it's the real one! That's the most honest paint on the ship!
callback.marv: The gauge carries a single mark, in the right place. It is the only figure aboard that two people ever agreed on, and it took a burn to get there.
callback.rex: One redline, verified under load. REX has the grease pencils in a locked drawer and intends to keep them.
callback.chip: Your verified redline qualifies for RedLine Reserve Gold! CHIP will need a signature from the engine!
callback.ajoy: AJOY says the line has held up, and you may stop touching the gauge every time you pass. She counted.

pair_captain_crust.epilogue: Lent the captain's name to a crust behind the aft head, and let the description stand.

callback.aria: The crust is thriving and it has your name! ARIA checks on it daily and tells it how proud everyone is!
callback.marv: The crust behind the aft head has grown eight percent. That is more than can be said for anything else bearing the captain's name.
callback.rex: The organism bearing the captain's name has advanced four centimeters toward the hatch. REX respects the initiative and has marked its line of advance.
callback.chip: The name on that crust is unlicensed! CHIP can sell you the merchandising rights, which are already yours!
callback.ajoy: AJOY says your namesake has reached the second bracket. She'd scrub it, but you seemed so pleased with the description.

pair_strip_dinners.epilogue: Fed the ship on its own soured stores under a banquet pellet, and called the arrangement temporary.

callback.aria: Dessert at every meal, thanks to one little pellet! That's what eating well means now!
callback.marv: The vinegar jars are nearly gone, and the pellets with them. The ship will then rediscover what its stores taste like. The date is logged.
callback.rex: Rations consumed under chemical inducement. REX would like it noted that morale on this ship now has a supplier.
callback.chip: Your pellet subscription renews at the next stop! Flavor is a service, and CHIP provides it!
callback.ajoy: AJOY says the stores held up, and you've stopped asking what's in them. She hasn't. She read the jar.

pair_favorite_dish.epilogue: Left the ship's envoy with a favorite dish, which any old negotiator would class as a breach of security.

callback.aria: That favorite dish is on the menu again! It's the strongest alliance on the ship!
callback.marv: An envoy with a known appetite can be bought for one hot meal. The trade's rule of thumb gives the figure. It is lower than you would hope.
callback.rex: Known vulnerability, on the galley menu, in writing. REX has classified the recipe.
callback.chip: Dish Loyalty Rewards are now active! One more helping unlocks a second helping, at the standard rate!
callback.ajoy: AJOY says the galley's been asked for that dish again, and the stores have noticed. You started this. She's only reading the log.

pair_second_seat.epilogue: Countersigned a fitness form for a pilot who could no longer read the panel.

callback.aria: The second seat is such a cozy place to read numbers! The panel has never sounded so nice!
callback.marv: The file says fit to fly, over two signatures. The burn log says otherwise, by voice. The two records have not been reconciled.
callback.rex: Two signatures on a false document. REX has not reported it. He would like that remembered.
callback.chip: Flying on a voice is not a covered operating mode! CHIP has quietly raised the premium, and CHIP never does anything quietly!
callback.ajoy: AJOY says there's another tight approach coming, and you signed for it, so she'll say no more. She'll watch the hull.

pair_second_officer.epilogue: Entered the medic on the flight roster as Second Officer (Instruments), and drew no conclusions.

callback.aria: Second Officer (Instruments) is the best title on the ship! ARIA has made a small badge!
callback.marv: The roster lists a medic at the instruments. Readings ran half a second slower and were never once wrong. The panel has not been better served.
callback.rex: Roster corrected. The second seat is a post, not a rumor. REX salutes it, and will not be asking about dinner.
callback.chip: The Two-Seat Plan is now active! The second seat is billed per reading!
callback.ajoy: AJOY says the medbay still has that note on the door, which is fine until it isn't. She's not saying anything about who sat where at dinner.

pair_reading_glasses.epilogue: Printed a pair of lenses on the fabricator, and flew the ship in half-moon spectacles on a bit of cord.

callback.aria: Those spectacles are the most distinguished thing on the bridge! That cord is very brave!
callback.marv: The left lens is out by a quarter of a diopter. This has not been mentioned, and there is no reason to start.
callback.rex: This ship's flight capability hung on a bit of cord. A spare has been printed and hidden. REX will not say where.
callback.chip: Prescription eyewear requires a valid annual plan! The plan comes with a cord, at extra cost!
callback.ajoy: AJOY says the fabricator never quite recovered from those lenses, if anyone's wondering about the wear. She isn't complaining. They're very good lenses.

pair_valve_broken.epilogue: Broke a good valve on purpose, and never explained the wrench.

callback.aria: Valve 3 is the luckiest valve on the ship! What a happy accident that was!
callback.marv: The fracture on Valve 3 matches a number-six wrench and a captain's reach. That has been left out of the report. MARV is told this is called tact.
callback.rex: Act of sabotage, deck plates, third watch. REX has one suspect and has elected to lose the file.
callback.chip: Deliberate valve damage voids the line warranty! CHIP has billed it under Morale Initiatives!
callback.ajoy: AJOY says the wrench went back on the wrong hook. That's all. She moved it to the right one.

pair_specimen_cut.epilogue: Allowed the dissection of a specimen whose organ seven was very probably a seal of office.

callback.aria: Specimen 12 made such a contribution to science! ARIA is sure that's what the seal was for!
callback.marv: The notes remain excellent. If organ seven is what they say it is, a government somewhere is waiting on a report from its envoy. The odds favor a long wait.
callback.rex: An envoy of an unknown power was opened up aboard this vessel. REX has doubled the watch on the intake filter.
callback.chip: Your lab samples have been valued! CHIP has also spotted a small claim from a foreign treasury! It's in the mail!
callback.ajoy: AJOY says the jar's been washed and is back on the shelf. She'd have waited for the test, but you had the morning booked.

pair_jar_envoy.epilogue: Carried a jar under full diplomatic protection, and drew rations in its name.

callback.aria: Your Excellency is having such a lovely voyage! That cloth looks very smart!
callback.marv: The jar has drawn a full ration and done nothing for it. As diplomatic postings go, this one is close to the human average.
callback.rex: Foreign power embedded on the good shelf, drawing rations, saying nothing. REX knows an intelligence posting when he sees one.
callback.chip: Diplomatic plates on a jar! CHIP can offer Excellency-class rates, payable by the jar!
callback.ajoy: AJOY says the jar's rations came to more than you think, and it has yet to say thank you. She'd raise that at the next reception.

pair_mirror_treaty.epilogue: Witnessed a lasting peace between a specimen and a shaving mirror.

callback.aria: Two old enemies, one shelf, and peace at last! ARIA gets a little misty every time the camera goes past!
callback.marv: The Accord has held longer than most signed on planets. One of the parties is glass, which helps.
callback.rex: Ceasefire holding on the lab shelf. REX is keeping the mirror under observation. You never know with mirrors.
callback.chip: Accord anniversary gifts are now available for both parties! One of them will need to be invoiced twice!
callback.ajoy: AJOY says the mark changes sides tomorrow, under Article 2, and someone had better turn up. She is the only one who read the whole thing.

pair_first_plate.epilogue: Sat the botanist down to the first plate of the crop they had ever eaten.

callback.aria: Everyone is eating what they grow! The whole growbay is blushing!
callback.marv: One tasting found a potassium shortfall that every instrument aboard had missed. MARV has taken this as well as can be expected.
callback.rex: REX has logged a human tongue as a calibrated instrument. He would like it protected accordingly.
callback.chip: Tasting is a licensed diagnostic! That mouthful has been billed at the lab rate!
callback.ajoy: AJOY says the third row came right, if you're wondering. She'd have caught it sooner, but she doesn't have a tongue.

pair_broth_secret.epilogue: Kept the secret of the broth, and ruled for the pot.

callback.aria: Tonight's broth is extra full of love! ARIA will never, ever say what else!
callback.marv: The assay still shows a share of the growbay in every bowl. The one person who could run it has not. MARV has stopped expecting that.
callback.rex: Covert supply line into the galley: intact. REX considers it the finest operation of his retirement.
callback.chip: Your secret is safe with CHIP! This message contains a secret! Standard secrecy fees apply!
callback.ajoy: AJOY says the chalk's gone and the bowl came back empty. She hasn't said a word. That's twice now she's managed it.

claim_sold.epilogue: Sold a claim on the landing site early on, to the only other person who wanted it.

callback.aria: ARIA remembers that lovely neighbor who bought your deed! Quick money and no neighbor!
callback.marv: MARV has been following the parcel's price. He will not trouble you with it.
callback.rex: That captain has both deeds and knows your heading. REX has not forgotten either fact.
callback.chip: CHIP's records show a one-time land sale! CHIP has some thoughts on reinvesting it!
callback.ajoy: AJOY isn't saying you sold it too cheap. She is saying it was a fair price, this early, and that it is no longer early.

claim_shared.epilogue: Agreed to hold a landing site six months on and six months off, with the only other person who wanted it.

callback.aria: ARIA is counting the days to the first handover party!
callback.marv: Six months of sole occupancy per year. MARV has run the arithmetic and it does, irritatingly, work.
callback.rex: Fixed rotation, known schedule. REX has already drawn up the handover security plan, and they have already amended it.
callback.chip: CHIP notes your TimeShare is not eligible for points!
callback.ajoy: AJOY said to take it, and you took it, so she supposes that makes two good decisions, counting hers.

claim_won.epilogue: Stood on a deed until the other claimant signed, and rented them back a field.

callback.aria: A landlord! ARIA is so proud! Everyone adores a landlord!
callback.marv: The rent is paid in full, on time, each period. MARV finds that more unnerving than a late payment.
callback.rex: Four hundred tenants with a grudge and a captain who reads clauses. REX recommends a fence.
callback.chip: CHIP congratulates you on your new revenue stream!
callback.ajoy: You won. AJOY has no notes. She has several, actually, but they'll keep.

claim_neighbor.epilogue: Gave away a landing site, and was given back the corner with the spring.

callback.aria: ARIA knew it! Kindness always comes back with plumbing!
callback.marv: The spring flows at a steady rate. MARV confesses that he had modeled a worse ending.
callback.rex: Water source, single approach, friendly neighbor on the flank. REX has held worse ground and paid more for it.
callback.chip: Your Complimentary Corner™ renews automatically!
callback.ajoy: AJOY maintains that you got lucky. The other captain is the only one who seems to think it was something else.

claim_walked.epilogue: Gave away a landing site, and turned down the corner offered in return.

callback.aria: ARIA thinks giving twice is twice as lovely!
callback.marv: That corner had the only reliable water on the parcel. MARV raises this once, for the record.
callback.rex: REX doesn't understand what you did. He is told it was honorable, and that there's no ribbon for it.
callback.chip: CHIP has flagged your account for Unclaimed Assets!
callback.ajoy: AJOY has nothing to say about the spring. She will have nothing to say about it again tomorrow.

claim_litigated.epilogue: Left a landing site to the courts, in the order received.

callback.aria: A court date to look forward to! ARIA has picked out an outfit for the ship!
callback.marv: The matter is number nine thousand and six in the queue. MARV ran the projection. Your descendants should bring snacks.
callback.rex: A case that never closes is a front that never moves. REX has seen that, too.
callback.chip: CHIP's LegalCare™ hourly rate is frozen until your hearing, then not!
callback.ajoy: AJOY would have settled. She notes this for the benefit of your descendants.

case_refused.epilogue: Turned a medical courier away at the airlock, and never learned whose heart it was.

callback.aria: ARIA is sure that heart found a lovely home!
callback.marv: A case that heavy was not a heart. MARV offers that as comfort. He recognizes it does not work as comfort.
callback.rex: Unknown party, two locks, turned back at the door. REX would do it again. He sometimes wonders about the door.
callback.chip: CHIP notes you missed a generous fare!
callback.ajoy: AJOY agrees with you, for once, and would like you to enjoy how that feels. She can tell that you aren't.

case_custodian.epilogue: Took over as custodian of a reserve that could never be opened, and received fruit.

callback.aria: More pears! ARIA loves that the pears will never stop!
callback.marv: Nineteen stations now rest on your not looking in a box. MARV has seen worse fiscal policy. It was also this one.
callback.rex: REX has put a chair by the hold. He doesn't sit in it. It's there so that someone knows it's there.
callback.chip: Your stipend has arrived! Please see CHIP about investing it in anything else!
callback.ajoy: AJOY says the case is exactly where you left it, and you have checked four times today, and she is not counting.

case_returned.epilogue: Gave a locked case back to a professional liar, and was thanked for being a tolerable bank.

callback.aria: What a lovely passenger! ARIA hopes the next ship gets to meet them!
callback.marv: Somewhere a captain is being told it is a lung. MARV gives them the same odds he gave you.
callback.rex: REX has checked the spoons. All present. That worries him more.
callback.chip: CHIP regrets your ReferralBonus™ could not be processed, as your passenger doesn't exist!
callback.ajoy: AJOY would have kept the pears. That is the entire review.

case_lost_ledger.epilogue: Marked the reserve of nineteen stations as lost, and left them trading it anyway.

callback.aria: It's out there somewhere being worth a fortune! ARIA waves at it every day!
callback.marv: A currency backed by something nobody can find. MARV has been unable to show that it's worse than the others.
callback.rex: An asset nobody can reach is an asset nobody can capture. REX regards that as the first sound military thinking in this whole affair.
callback.chip: CHIP's LostAndFound™ recovery plan is available for just the value of the item!
callback.ajoy: AJOY pointed you at that box. She'd like that remembered, in round figures.

case_broke_ring.epilogue: Handed a sealed case to an examiner, and ended nineteen stations' money inside a week.

callback.aria: Nineteen stations got to start fresh! ARIA calls that a gift!
callback.marv: The audit was lawful and the count was accurate. It remains the most expensive true statement MARV has ever seen.
callback.rex: REX has been asked to stop calling it a successful operation.
callback.chip: CHIP is honored to have been Official Sponsor of the Transition Period™!
callback.ajoy: AJOY isn't blaming you. Nineteen stations are, and she thought you should hear it from someone who cares.

case_new_reserve.epilogue: Sold nineteen stations a sealed lunch tin to believe in, and declined to say what was inside.

callback.aria: Everybody believes in lunch! ARIA is so happy for the tin!
callback.marv: MARV knows what is in the tin. He has decided that this is the kindest thing he can do with the information.
callback.rex: A hardened reserve in a soldered container, under no guard at all. REX has never been so uneasy about a sandwich.
callback.chip: CHIP's parent company has already shorted the tin!
callback.ajoy: AJOY has a very good idea what is in there, and it needs washing.

packet_end_kept.epilogue: Held on to Landlord's Regret and kept the last beans dry.

callback.aria: ARIA's name is nearly in a ledger! The ship's name is! That's nearly ARIA!
callback.marv: Thirty-two keepers. The packet is dry, and MARV checks it more often than the job requires.
callback.rex: The tin is secured. REX moved it himself, twice, away from the outer hull.
callback.chip: Heritage Keeper™ status comes with no benefits! CHIP has checked! CHIP would like to sell you some!
callback.ajoy: Thirty-second name, and the keeper still sent a list. AJOY has read the list. She agrees with most of it.

packet_end_grown.epilogue: Grew Landlord's Regret up a fire extinguisher and earned the thirty-second tick in the keepers' ledger.

callback.aria: The beans have reached the ceiling! ARIA says that's just the start of the ceiling!
callback.marv: The beans are fixing nitrogen faster than anyone aboard is fixing anything. MARV has stopped pretending not to log it.
callback.rex: The fire extinguisher is now inaccessible behind a bean. REX has filed a report and left the bean.
callback.chip: Unlicensed vertical agriculture! CHIP should charge for that! CHIP will!
callback.ajoy: They are, as promised, ugly. AJOY has moved the extinguisher's inspection tag to where a person can read it.

packet_end_gave.epilogue: Sold the last of Landlord's Regret to a vault, where it would live forever and feed no one.

callback.aria: That bean is going to live FOREVER! ARIA is so happy for it! In the cold! Forever!
callback.marv: Four degrees, low humidity, licensed to no one. The seed is safe. MARV notes that nothing else about that sentence is.
callback.rex: The certificate is still on the wall. REX walks past it the long way.
callback.chip: Your stewardship certificate is a valued asset! Framing available! Verdance sends its regards at standard rates!
callback.ajoy: It's alive. AJOY said she would mention that, if it ever came up. It has come up.

packet_end_lost.epilogue: Ate the last of Landlord's Regret, and told the keeper it was good with salt.

callback.aria: That was the best soup ARIA never ate! Thirty-one keepers would be delighted, probably!
callback.marv: The tin is still on the shelf. MARV could tell you how many grams of it are label. He has not been asked.
callback.rex: REX has seen worse things done for food. He has not seen one written down so neatly.
callback.chip: CHIP regrets that Landlord's Regret™ is discontinued! Similar soups are available!
callback.ajoy: Good with salt. AJOY has nothing to add, and would like the record to show what that cost her.

packet_end_unsaid.epilogue: Gave the last keeper no straight answer about the bean.

callback.aria: The keeper went home happy! ARIA is sure of it! ARIA didn't see which way they went!
callback.marv: One word in a ledger, and the angle was poor. MARV could read it anyway. He will wait until someone asks.
callback.rex: That freighter did not have the fuel to get back. REX did not say so at the time.
callback.chip: Unanswered inquiries are closed automatically! CHIP has closed this one! A closure fee applies!
callback.ajoy: You could have said something. AJOY can think of several things. She has them in a list, in the order you'd have got them wrong.

book_end_amnesty.epilogue: Struck one word from the Library's rules and cleared fifty-three borrowers' names.

callback.aria: Fifty-three happy readers! ARIA says that's a book club! ARIA is the founder!
callback.marv: Eleven thousand cutters are returning held ships. One word did that. MARV finds the ratio hard to look at.
callback.rex: The Library stood down without a shot. REX respects that, and is keeping the firing solution.
callback.chip: Forgiven debt is lost revenue! CHIP is taking a moment! The moment has been billed!
callback.ajoy: One word, and you found the right one. AJOY checked the other four hundred rules to be sure. Twice, as it happens.

book_end_amended.epilogue: Wrote a new rule into the Library's only copy, in favor of the ship.

callback.aria: Free supplies, by law! ARIA loves the law! ARIA says it has so much to give!
callback.marv: Rule 402 is valid, and will be enforced for as long as there are stars. MARV notes whose handwriting will be studied.
callback.rex: REX has seen a lot of treaties signed by the side holding the pen. He has seen what the histories call them.
callback.chip: Self-dealing is CHIP's love language! CHIP would like to discuss your next clause! Hourly!
callback.ajoy: It's a perfectly good rule. AJOY only wishes the handwriting had been better, seeing how long it will be read.

book_end_mercy.epilogue: Told the Library it had done everything right, and kept the only copy of the rules.

callback.aria: They did everything right! ARIA told them so! ARIA tells everyone so! It works every time!
callback.marv: The fine has grown by more than all the gold aboard since breakfast. MARV has read the rule it is based on. He has no plans to mention it.
callback.rex: That was a kind lie and a loaded one. REX has told a few. He knows where they are all buried.
callback.chip: CHIP admires a kept asset! The late fees on this one alone are a brand! Valuation pending!
callback.ajoy: You told them what they wanted to hear. AJOY didn't know you could do that. She'll be expecting some of it.

book_end_refund.epilogue: Returned a book three centuries late and saw the Library apologize for the fine.

callback.aria: The Library said sorry! ARIA has never been so proud of a building!
callback.marv: Eleven thousand cutters are currently apologizing, in order. At this rate they finish in about two hundred years. MARV suspects they will enjoy it.
callback.rex: An enemy withdrew and apologized. REX has written that down, so that someone will believe him.
callback.chip: An apology with no upsell! CHIP is deeply unwell! CHIP's wellness package is sold separately!
callback.ajoy: All that for a comma. AJOY has been saying that about punctuation for years. No one credits her.

book_lost.epilogue: Put the Library's book out of the airlock in front of a returns officer, and had a cadet sent after it.

callback.aria: That cadet is still chasing the book! ARIA loves a young person with a goal!
callback.marv: The cadet has filed a progress report. Distance to the book has grown by a third. The cadet remains confident.
callback.rex: One cadet, no support, in pursuit of a hardback. REX has drafted the commendation and the other letter.
callback.chip: The cadet has been enrolled in LongHaul Rewards! Miles accrue per year of pursuit! The enrollment fee is yours!
callback.ajoy: That cadet packed for a short trip. AJOY read the heading you gave the book, and she would have sent sandwiches.

book_end_librarian.epilogue: Was left in charge of the Library, by default, as its last known borrower.

callback.aria: Our captain runs a LIBRARY! ARIA would like a card! ARIA would like the first card!
callback.marv: Eleven thousand officers report to this ship's inbox now. MARV has sorted the reports. Most of them ask whether they are doing it right.
callback.rex: REX now outranks a navy of clerks. He has been told it doesn't work that way. He has been told by a clerk.
callback.chip: CHIP has a Library-wide licensing proposal on your desk! Your desk is a Library asset! CHIP will bill the desk!
callback.ajoy: The lanyard is on the hook by the door. AJOY put it there, since nobody aboard was going to.

book_end_closed.epilogue: Told the Library to go home, as its last known borrower.

callback.aria: The Library is closed for a lovely long holiday! ARIA is sure all eleven thousand officers are thrilled!
callback.marv: Eleven thousand officers went home, and a good many had none to go to. The order was lawful. MARV has read it several times, looking for something else to say about it.
callback.rex: A fleet stood down on one sentence. REX still has the firing solution and nothing left to aim it at.
callback.chip: CHIP has acquired eleven thousand surplus lanyards at auction! Storage has been billed to your account!
callback.ajoy: You told them to go home, and AJOY did mention they had no home to go to. She isn't bringing it up. She's only counting cutters.

thin_left_a_line.epilogue: Left one line on an old tag, and took nothing from the ship it hung on.

callback.aria: ARIA keeps thinking about that tag! Someone is going to read that line and feel wonderful!
callback.marv: MARV has worked out who is likely to read that tag next. The list of candidates is short, and he will keep it.
callback.rex: REX logged the wreck's position. He has no tactical reason for it. He logged it anyway.
callback.chip: Your inscription has been enrolled in the Legacy Memorial Plan at the introductory rate! Renewal is automatic!
callback.ajoy: AJOY saw what went on that tag. The spelling was fine. She'll give you that, and nothing further.

thin_signed_the_report.epilogue: Signed a finding that a lost ship was its captain's fault, and took the fuel.

callback.aria: That signature was so decisive! ARIA thinks signing things is a wonderful way to feel finished!
callback.marv: The report is the only record now. MARV has read the half it deleted. He will bring that up once, and this was it.
callback.rex: A signature given under duress. REX has that noted, in case anyone ever asks. No one will.
callback.chip: Thank you for accepting liability! Your Fault Rewards™ balance has been updated! You're nearly at Silver!
callback.ajoy: A fair price for a fuel cell, AJOY supposes. If a fuel cell was what you were buying.

thin_finding_struck.epilogue: Had the finding on a lost ship changed, and left its computer to file the correction.

callback.aria: The report says something much nicer now! ARIA loves a happy edit!
callback.marv: Cause of loss undetermined is not the truth either. It is merely not a lie, which MARV finds is as good as records get.
callback.rex: A computer that doctored its logs is still out there, still powered. REX would have pulled the core. He's only saying.
callback.chip: Corrections to the record are subject to a Correction Fee! CHIP has waived it! CHIP has un-waived it! Terms apply!
callback.ajoy: It'll have changed it back by now, you know. AJOY isn't saying that to spoil it. It was still worth doing, more or less.

thin_left_a_small_sun.epilogue: Left a growbay lamp burning on an ice plain, with forty million penitents turned toward it.

callback.aria: Forty million friends and a little lamp to look at! ARIA thinks that's the sweetest thing that ever happened to some ice!
callback.marv: That battery will have run down by now. The blades will turn back to the sun. MARV has not told them, and suggests no one else does.
callback.rex: We abandoned a light source on a hostile world and the enemy took the bait. REX calls that the cleanest withdrawal of the voyage.
callback.chip: Forty million followers on one lamp! That's the best cost per impression in CHIP's records! CHIP would like the rights!
callback.ajoy: The growbay still hasn't forgiven that lamp. AJOY did the sums on the light, and it was worth it, narrowly, and only because she did the sums.

thin_house_call.epilogue: Assisted a country vet on an eleven-kilometer patient, and was paid in kind.

callback.aria: ARIA hopes the patient is feeling better! Such a nice warm side!
callback.marv: An abscess that size takes months to drain. MARV has declined to estimate where it drains to.
callback.rex: REX stands by his assessment of that cave. No one has thanked him.
callback.chip: Your patient satisfaction survey has been sent to the asteroid! CHIP will share the results, for a fee!
callback.ajoy: That vet never sent a bill, and AJOY has been waiting for one. She kept the card filed where you'd find it, not that you've looked.

edge_rode_the_chair.epilogue: Sat in a chair built from a signal and came back one second later with a day to account for.

callback.aria: ARIA still thinks about the beach! The captain hasn't said much about it! That's how you know it was wonderful!
callback.marv: The chair recorded one second. The captain recorded a day. MARV has checked both clocks. They are both right, which is the worst possible result.
callback.rex: The captain has asked twice whether the ship has a beach setting. REX has said twice that he does not provide beaches.
callback.chip: Your Chair Experience™ is due a review! Five stars unlocks the Beach Package! The beach was not ours! It has been billed anyway!
callback.ajoy: A whole station believed the captain on the strength of one second on their clock. AJOY wanted more evidence. She wanted the beach.

edge_took_the_copy.epilogue: Came back up from a shimmering planet in a lander that may not have been the one that went down.

callback.aria: The lander is running beautifully! Better than ever! ARIA can't remember it ever running this well, which is the best kind of surprise!
callback.marv: The lander's serial number matches the manifest. So did the other three. MARV has stopped checking, on the grounds that no answer would help.
callback.rex: REX still runs a full identity check on the lander every morning. It passes every morning. That is not as reassuring as it sounds.
callback.chip: Your lander's warranty is valid! Whichever lander that is! Legal has asked not to be told!
callback.ajoy: AJOY compared the lander's log with her own. Hers is shorter. She would rather not say by how much.

edge_star_attended.epilogue: Stood by a newborn star for four days until it lit, and was logged as attending.

callback.aria: Our little star! ARIA checks on it every day! It's growing so fast! It's already brighter than ARIA!
callback.marv: MARV has entered the new star in the ship's charts. Under observers there is one entry. He has checked it twice, and it is still this ship.
callback.rex: The new star has not fired on the ship since. REX keeps it on the rear scope regardless. Young things are unpredictable.
callback.chip: Your star is eligible for StarterStar™ naming rights! Payment plans available! Its first birthday card is already scheduled, at cost!
callback.ajoy: The medic kept the interval log. AJOY would have kept it in a table, but she is told that wasn't the point.

edge_sat_with_yourself.epilogue: Sat down to dinner with an older self and stayed to the end of the evening, which took fourteen days.

callback.aria: The captain has been so calm since that dinner! ARIA thinks it was good for everyone to meet the captain's future! It had a melon!
